programme.title: 雪兒: 她的故事
programme.desc: 走進 Cher 的世界——這位歷久不衰的傳奇人物,從平凡起步到超級巨星,她的旅程在五十多年來深刻影響了流行文化。

programme.title: 妮可基嫚: 走向奧斯卡
programme.desc: 這部專題紀錄片聚焦澳洲傳奇 Nicole Kidman 的早年生活、電影事業,以及她所經歷的高低起伏。從叢林中的聖誕節到奧斯卡得主,她的故事充滿啟發與考驗。

programme.title: 紅粉佳人: 無所畏懼
programme.desc: P!nk 是流行與搖滾樂壇的強大存在。雖然她最初被視為九○年代末眾多青少年流行歌手之一,但她最終開創了屬於自己的音樂風格,並穩固了無可取代的地位。她,是當今樂壇不可忽視的力量。

programme.title: 雪兒: 她的故事
programme.desc: 走進 Cher 的世界——這位歷久不衰的傳奇人物,從平凡起步到超級巨星,她的旅程在五十多年來深刻影響了流行文化。

programme.title: 海獵人 #6
programme.desc: 在巴塔哥尼亞瓦爾德斯半島的中心,鯨魚經常遭到一種體型嬌小卻意圖兇殘的掠食者襲擊——海鷗。牠們迫使鯨魚潛入深海,遠離賴以生存的氧氣與光線。

programme.title: 海獵人 #1
programme.desc: 每年春天,在挪威海域,鯨魚會運用一種聰明的捕獵技巧——「氣泡網捕食」來捕捉大量鯡魚。當牠們發現魚群時,便開始包圍獵物,並不斷釋放氣泡形成一道空氣幕牆,將魚群困在其中。

programme.title: 海獵人 #2
programme.desc: 海洋生物學家伊芙・朱爾丹與理查德・考利奧森,已在挪威研究虎鯨兩年之久,觀察牠們如何將「旋轉圍捕」技巧適應於當地環境。

programme.title: 海獵人 #3
programme.desc: 在深海之中,敏捷迅速的海獅展現驚人的水下動作,以智取敵人。在巴塔哥尼亞的海灘上,一隻幼海獅正學習游泳,而掠食者已悄然準備發動致命攻擊。

programme.title: 海獵人 #4
programme.desc: 好望角塘鵝是強悍的獵手,翱翔海岸尋找最愛的獵物——沙丁魚群,並等待一位意想不到的盟友: 海豚的協助。

programme.title: 海獵人 #5
programme.desc: 在好望角十字角炙熱的陽光下,大批海豹群聚於納米比亞骷髏海岸。雄性海豹體重可達 360 公斤,巡守領域以保護雌性與幼崽。然而,新的陸地掠食者正逼近,迫使牠們學習全新的防禦行為。

programme.title: 海獵人 #6
programme.desc: 在巴塔哥尼亞瓦爾德斯半島的中心,鯨魚經常遭到一種體型嬌小卻意圖兇殘的掠食者襲擊——海鷗。牠們迫使鯨魚潛入深海,遠離賴以生存的氧氣與光線。

programme.title: 進化中的素食者 #5
programme.desc: 德州中心深處是一片素食綠洲;文拿探索另類令人驚喜的德州美味素食: 炸雞、巨大无比的餅乾、排骨包和垂涎欲滴的素牛腩。

programme.title: 進化中的素食者 #6
programme.desc: 文拿回鄉與饒舌歌手海特什夏爾馬一起製作素雪糕,然後繞回家品嚐媽媽做的埃及菜。

programme.title: 北領地好味道 #1
programme.desc: 占美前往繁忙的湍溪市場,穿梭在熟食檔、農夫和每週採購的當地人之間。

programme.title: 北領地好味道 #2
programme.desc: 占美拜訪一些正為希臘文化節準備食物的希臘社區;他到訪色彩繽紛的馬拉克夜市。

programme.title: 維修的奧祕 2 #4
programme.desc: 米克大衛臣加入正準備接受試驗的美國海軍陸戰隊的「重型運輸機」中隊。他們致力保持CH53「超級種馬」直升機機隊飛行,為在沙漠和山區進行激戰的訓練演習作準備。

programme.title: 維修的奧祕 2 #5
programme.desc: 米克大衛臣展開一場跨國公路旅行,以幫助井井有條基金會。他們致力尋找並封鎖全美各地估計200萬個洩漏、有毒、可能致命的廢棄石油和天然氣井。

programme.title: 維修的奧祕 2 #6
programme.desc: 米克大衛臣加入世上最極端、最容易發生雪崩的滑雪山之一- 雪鳥的團隊。他們使用鏟子、壓雪車,甚至二戰的榴彈砲,奮力保衛陡峭斜坡的安全。

programme.title: 起司愛旅 #1
programme.desc: 起司大師阿弗林・普里斯汀的起司探險之旅從阿爾卑斯山國瑞士展開,這裡是格魯耶爾與經典孔洞艾門塔起司的故鄉。

programme.title: 起司愛旅 #2
programme.desc: 在法國,吃起司幾乎是一項全民嗜好。阿弗林走訪巴黎到諾曼第,探索全國各地悠久而豐富的起司製作歷史。

programme.title: 起司愛旅 #3
programme.desc: 阿弗林深入加拿大魁北克的濃厚起司傳統,當地家族乳酪坊的技藝世代相傳,延續至今。

programme.title: 起司愛旅 #4
programme.desc: 阿弗林在自己的家鄉多倫多展開一場迷你環球起司之旅,這座城市是世界上最多元且充滿文化魅力的地方之一。

programme.title: 起司愛旅 #5
programme.desc: 阿弗林的起司尋味之旅來到希臘——菲達起司的發源地,起司文化可追溯至數千年前的古老傳統。

programme.title: 起司愛旅 #6
programme.desc: 阿弗林的最後一站是風景如畫的加拿大卑詩省西岸,當地創新的起司文化由「支持在地」的精神所驅動。

programme.title: 內馬爾: 巴西頭號射手
programme.desc: 從山度士街頭到成為巴西隊頭號射手,內馬爾20年的歷程值得載入史冊。內馬爾幾乎在每個大洲都踢過足球,他將永遠成為球壇的傳說。

programme.title: 布魯斯威利: 全美英雄
programme.desc: 布斯韋利士憑著在《虎膽龍威》中飾演尊麥堅這個標誌性角色而成為巨星,他在傳奇的演藝生涯演出過百部電影。他以魅力和幽默而聞名,但卻在2022年遭遇悲慘的挫折。

programme.title: 湯姆漢克斯: 演無不克
programme.desc: 從出身卑微到成為有抱負的演員,再到扮演世上最具標誌性和最著名的角色。他贏得了「美國好人」、「平民」和藝術游牧民的美譽。而我們都知道他……是 湯姆漢克斯。

programme.title: 空中戰士 11 #1
programme.desc: 這部紀錄片系列展示五代噴射機。這些戰機能夠攜帶炸彈並飛近太空邊緣。第六代戰機從2020年開始服役,第11季至今已經覆蓋了大部分此後的空中兵器。

programme.title: 空中戰士 11 #2
programme.desc: 這部紀錄片系列展示五代噴射機。這些戰機能夠攜帶炸彈並飛近太空邊緣。第六代戰機從2020年開始服役,第11季至今已經覆蓋了大部分此後的空中兵器。

programme.title: 海獵人 #4

programme.title: 海獵人 #6

programme.title: The Dog Rescuers
programme.desc: In Greater Manchester shockingly injured Saluki Susie limps onto a petrol station forecourt and into Inspector Becky Goulding's life Susie's found with football socks tied tightly around her legs One fractured leg is damaged beyond repair and has to be removed After Susie's sad start will she find her happy ending?

programme.title: Cute Pets At Home
programme.desc: Ali the elephant at Shoushan Zoo, carries the childhood memories of many children, both young and old Although he is now 49 years old, he is still energetic under the care of the keepers Once the new zoo is completed, the public will be able to see "Ali" again When the caregiver helps Ali take a shower, Ali will take the opportunity to replenish his body with water; sometimes he will step on water in the pool and use his nose to enjoy the fun of playing in the water nThere are currently only three African elephants in Taiwan In addition to Ali, the other two are in the Taipei City Zoo Because African elephants are endangered wild animals, their import and export are strictly controlled If these three elephants die in the future, Taiwan may no longer see any African elephants Shoushan Zoo vows to take good care of "Ali" so that "Ali's" heartwarming story can continue, and shoulder the mission of life education, so that everyone's visit to the Shoushan Zoo is the starting point of happy memories In addition to Ali the elephant, Shoushan Zoo currently has two white rhinos, male "Xiqi" from the Taipei City Zoo and female "Baby" who was bred naturally in the zoo nWhite rhino "Xiqi" was loaned to Shoushan Zoo in hope that he could successfully mate with the female white rhino "Baby" to raise the white rhino population

programme.title: 非自然死亡 6 #1
programme.desc: 一名 71 歲男子被發現倒臥田間中彈身亡,調查人員一開始懷疑是搶劫殺人。然而隨著新證據浮現,偵探們提出一個離奇的理論來解釋他的死因,而唯有受害者「來自墳墓的聲音」能證實真相。

programme.title: 非自然死亡 6 #2
programme.desc: 一名女子在底特律飯店猝然身亡,隨之揭開的是一張充滿秘密、謊言與致命巧合的黑暗之網——所有跡象都暗示著一股更加邪惡的力量。

programme.title: 非自然死亡 6 #3
programme.desc: 一名海軍軍官在海上待了數月後因神祕病症死亡,毫無線索,直到驗屍揭露驚人真相。所有調查線索都走入死胡同——直到他們鎖定了一個最不可能的嫌疑人。

programme.title: 非自然死亡 6 #4
programme.desc: 一名忠誠的丈夫、軍人、三個孩子的父親,親自打電話向警方做出毛骨悚然的自白: 他射殺了自己的妻子。原本看似單純的凶殺案,很快就演變成更加複雜的真相。

programme.title: 非自然死亡 6 #5
programme.desc: 當黛安娜巴羅被發現失去意識時,家屬與警方起初認為她死於自然原因,直到小鎮流言揭露,鄰里中的罪犯可能隱藏著致命祕密。

programme.title: 非自然死亡 6 #6
programme.desc: 看似毫不相關的兩起事件——卡車火災與失蹤人口通報——最終在一宗致命的身分錯認案件中交會。

programme.title: 非自然死亡 6 #7
programme.desc: 一名富有寡婦的猝死讓調查人員困惑不已。隨著死因相互矛盾,加上牽涉數百萬財產,嫌疑逐漸指向她最親近的人。

programme.title: 非自然死亡 6 #8
programme.desc: 一名馬廄看護表面上的自殺事件,在多年後因出現幾乎一模一樣的犯罪現場而遭到質疑,暗示可能有連環殺手在活動。

programme.title: 非自然死亡 6 #9
programme.desc: 一名休班警察撥打 911 報案,稱妻子昏迷不醒。隨著疑點逐漸浮現,所有懷疑都指向他可能涉案,但一個出乎意料的轉折,徹底改變了一切。

programme.title: 非自然死亡 6 #10

programme.title: 非自然死亡 6 #4

programme.title: 非自然死亡 6 #5

programme.title: 和山田談場LV999的戀愛 #6
programme.desc: 由琉奈的惡作劇引發的騷動,在山田和其他公會成員的調停下順利落幕,茜也接受了琉奈的道歉。後來茜因與琉奈關係改善,對FOS的熱情也愈加高漲,終於和山田在遊戲中正式成為好友。然而,因為她長時間沉迷網遊,讓電腦過度負荷,某天茜的電腦突然爆炸了。

programme.title: 海賊王 #23
programme.desc: 為了營救艾斯,白鬍子海賊團與海軍本部、七武海在馬林福特爆發激戰,而魯夫也率領越獄犯加入戰場。魯夫成功救出艾斯,但艾斯卻為了保護他而被赤犬擊殺,白鬍子亦戰死。戰爭最終在紅髮傑克的介入下落幕。經此一戰,魯夫與夥伴們決定分別修行兩年後再會。

programme.desc: 音無剛一認同了莉音得出的答案。不過琴子卻加以否定,篤定地斷言澄並非是因自殺而死,真兇另有其人!其實她掌握著從妖狐那裡打聽來且尚未公開的「某個重大真相」。真正的凶手究竟是誰?

programme.title: 虛構推理 (第二季) #12
programme.desc: 妻子的雪枝在烤鰻魚老店遭強盜殺害後,隆也被朋友的十條寺良太郎質問。對方猜測隆也就是殺人犯,還裝出一副憔悴的樣子以免被懷疑。在店裡面的座位吃高級鰻魚飯的琴子也被捲入其中,摻雜怪異現象的非凡日常逐漸被揭露。

programme.title: 排球少年 (第二季) #25
programme.desc: 烏野高中進入了決賽,他們想要贏下比賽並於全國賽中代表宮城縣出賽。

programme.title: 排球少年!! (第三季) #1
programme.desc: 由烏野高中對上白鳥澤學園高中。白鳥澤的主將-牛島若利是眾人公認的強者,烏野的每個人都戰戰兢兢的備戰。

programme.title: 愚蠢天使與惡魔共舞 #10
programme.desc: 莉莉的哥哥「扎維」突然出現在阿久津和莉莉面前。阿久津被他那紳士風度般的態度當中所隱含的某種令人生畏的氣息給震撼,莉莉則是丟下他和扎維一同離去。阿久津很在意莉莉離去時那不自然的笑容,當他追上他們兩人時,他看到因為被扎維拿刀指著而嚇得渾身發抖的莉莉。

programme.title: 愚蠢天使與惡魔共舞 #11
programme.desc: 莉莉因為被扎維給打傷而哭泣。目睹了這一幕的阿久津,其憤怒達到了巔峰,因而覺醒了惡魔之力。他以壓倒性的力量擊倒扎維,就在他準備給予其致命一擊的瞬間,莉莉擋在了他的面前。然而,阿久津卻因為憤怒而失去了理智,甚至想要攻擊莉莉……!?

programme.title: WITCH WATCH 魔女守護者 #3
programme.desc: 多虧適應性高到誇張的同班同學們,雖然身分曝光,妮可和守仁仍能過著一如往常的生活。某日,妮可和守仁收到了妮可的母親伊吹寄來的行李和信,信中提到了妮可有關的新預言,表示「狗和雨滴會帶來災難」。守仁雖然感到困惑,還是針對這些事處處留心……

programme.title: WITCH WATCH 魔女守護者 #4
programme.desc: 烏鴉的使魔風祭監志為了守護妮可出現在妮可及守仁面前。監志是天狗,居住在妮可進行魔法修行的山中。他和守仁一樣在伊吹的拜託下擔任妮可的護衛。但監志卻單方面敵視身為鬼的守仁。妮可和守仁的同居生活,現在又有監志這個新人物加入了?

programme.desc: 烏鴉的使魔風祭監志為了守護妮可出現在妮可及守仁面前。監志是天狗,居住在妮可進行魔法修行的山中。他和守仁一樣在伊吹的拜託下擔任妮可的護衛。但監志卻單方面敵視身為鬼的守仁。妮可和守仁的同居生活,現在又有監志這個新人物加入了?

programme.title: 排球少年 (第二季) #25
programme.desc: 烏野高中進入了決賽,他們想要贏下比賽並於全國賽中代表宮城縣出賽。

programme.title: 機動戰士高達 水星的魔女 SEASON2 #24
programme.desc: 風靈被激光動力傳輸系統嚴重摧毀。接下來會發生什麼?

programme.title: 魔法水果籃 第一季 #1
programme.desc: 母親去世之後,少女本田透在森林裡搭起帳篷居住,沒想到這片森林是由神奇的草摩家族所掌管。

programme.title: 愚蠢天使與惡魔共舞 #10
programme.desc: 莉莉的哥哥「扎維」突然出現在阿久津和莉莉面前。阿久津被他那紳士風度般的態度當中所隱含的某種令人生畏的氣息給震撼,莉莉則是丟下他和扎維一同離去。阿久津很在意莉莉離去時那不自然的笑容,當他追上他們兩人時,他看到因為被扎維拿刀指著而嚇得渾身發抖的莉莉。

programme.title: 愚蠢天使與惡魔共舞 #11
programme.desc: 莉莉因為被扎維給打傷而哭泣。目睹了這一幕的阿久津,其憤怒達到了巔峰,因而覺醒了惡魔之力。他以壓倒性的力量擊倒扎維,就在他準備給予其致命一擊的瞬間,莉莉擋在了他的面前。然而,阿久津卻因為憤怒而失去了理智,甚至想要攻擊莉莉……!?

programme.title: 愚蠢天使與惡魔共舞 #12
programme.desc: 阿久津在自己的公寓與莉莉亞交談。莉莉亞講述了莉莉的出身以及她拼命建立起來的地位,並與破壞這一切阿久津展開對峙……同時,莉莉在阿久津的床上醒來後,誤以為自己在睡覺時被他給○○了,於是便揮刀砍向阿久津。

programme.title: 她去公爵家的理由 #9
programme.desc: 萊利娜為了聖火儀式被賦予了嚴苛任務,疲憊不已的她來到泉水邊,也因此救起了一隻溺水的鳥。但剛好在場的大神官希卡認為去救註定要死的鳥只是白費功夫,兩人因此起了口角。希卡事後遍尋整個神殿,卻怎麼都找不到那個對自己失禮,但又令人在意不已的萊利娜。

programme.title: 她去公爵家的理由 #10
programme.desc: 希卡看中萊利娜的才能,為了收她為徒而拚盡全力。他不僅打開了那道鮮少開啟,通往神聖國的大門,召喚出聖騎士團,以展現大神官的威嚴,甚至還為了表現親和力,而說出可以叫他「爺爺」的這種話。就在此時,萊利娜配戴的珠寶髮飾發出了詭異的光芒。

programme.title: 她去公爵家的理由 #11
programme.desc: 女僕告誡萊利娜千萬不能去看位於西館深處的鏡子。因為有傳聞說若和鏡中魂四目交接,它就會告訴來者任何事情。但萊利娜想知道小說女主角貝兒托利絲的所在,仍在夜晚拿起了鏡子。當奇怪的聲音嚇得萊利娜縮起身體時,出現在她面前的竟不是鏡中魂,而是努爾。

programme.title: 她去公爵家的理由 #12
programme.desc: 努爾拜訪了現今國王,也是他的異母哥哥希亞托里希。當他終於開口提到自己與萊利娜所締結之契約,希亞托里希當面指出,現在議會會期即將結束,應該已不再需要這個婚約的事實。與此同時,萊利娜前往溫奈特家墓地,貝兒托利絲是否會如同小說所描寫的一樣出現呢?

programme.title: 海賊王 #22
programme.desc: 為了營救艾斯,白鬍子海賊團與海軍本部、七武海在馬林福特爆發激戰,而魯夫也率領越獄犯加入戰場。魯夫成功救出艾斯,但艾斯卻為了保護他而被赤犬擊殺,白鬍子亦戰死。戰爭最終在紅髮傑克的介入下落幕。經此一戰,魯夫與夥伴們決定分別修行兩年後再會。

programme.desc: 已經是最後一局了,準決賽的勝利會落在烏野高中還是青葉城西高中的手中呢?

programme.title: 排球少年 (第二季) #25
programme.desc: 烏野高中進入了決賽,他們想要贏下比賽並於全國賽中代表宮城縣出賽。

programme.title: 排球少年!! (第三季) #1
programme.desc: 由烏野高中對上白鳥澤學園高中。白鳥澤的主將-牛島若利是眾人公認的強者,烏野的每個人都戰戰兢兢的備戰。

programme.title: 排球少年!! (第三季) #2
programme.desc: 跟白鳥澤之戰開打,一開始牛島就不斷的進攻,連得了好幾分。面對左撇子主攻手,西谷表示只要給他三球,他就可以接下來,但即使如此第一局還是被白鳥澤拿下。

programme.title: 她去公爵家的理由 #9
programme.desc: 萊利娜為了聖火儀式被賦予了嚴苛任務,疲憊不已的她來到泉水邊,也因此救起了一隻溺水的鳥。但剛好在場的大神官希卡認為去救註定要死的鳥只是白費功夫,兩人因此起了口角。希卡事後遍尋整個神殿,卻怎麼都找不到那個對自己失禮,但又令人在意不已的萊利娜。

programme.title: 她去公爵家的理由 #10
programme.desc: 希卡看中萊利娜的才能,為了收她為徒而拚盡全力。他不僅打開了那道鮮少開啟,通往神聖國的大門,召喚出聖騎士團,以展現大神官的威嚴,甚至還為了表現親和力,而說出可以叫他「爺爺」的這種話。就在此時,萊利娜配戴的珠寶髮飾發出了詭異的光芒。

programme.title: 她去公爵家的理由 #11
programme.desc: 女僕告誡萊利娜千萬不能去看位於西館深處的鏡子。因為有傳聞說若和鏡中魂四目交接,它就會告訴來者任何事情。但萊利娜想知道小說女主角貝兒托利絲的所在,仍在夜晚拿起了鏡子。當奇怪的聲音嚇得萊利娜縮起身體時,出現在她面前的竟不是鏡中魂,而是努爾。

programme.title: 她去公爵家的理由 #12
programme.desc: 努爾拜訪了現今國王,也是他的異母哥哥希亞托里希。當他終於開口提到自己與萊利娜所締結之契約,希亞托里希當面指出,現在議會會期即將結束,應該已不再需要這個婚約的事實。與此同時,萊利娜前往溫奈特家墓地,貝兒托利絲是否會如同小說所描寫的一樣出現呢?

programme.title: 和山田談場LV999的戀愛 #4
programme.desc: 茜參加了在FOS聯名咖啡廳舉辦的公會線下聚會。雖然她認出山田與疑似是琉璃姬的兩人,但對於現場出現的兩位男性──瑛太與鴨田卻完全沒印象。在自我介紹時,鴨田自稱是在FOS中名叫takezo的草莓農夫。而另一位瑛太則是茜萬萬沒想到的某位玩家。

programme.title: 和山田談場LV999的戀愛 #5
programme.desc: 茜雖然想和公會成員們打好關係,但她隱約察覺到瑛太的妹妹琉奈有所保留的態度。琉奈主動邀她去咖啡廳,讓茜一度心情大好。但這其實是琉奈的惡作劇,在現場等著的是自稱琉璃姬狂熱粉絲的陌生男子。而到佐佐木家擔任家教的山田察覺到琉奈的神情異常。

programme.title: 和山田談場LV999的戀愛 #6
programme.desc: 由琉奈的惡作劇引發的騷動,在山田和其他公會成員的調停下順利落幕,茜也接受了琉奈的道歉。後來茜因與琉奈關係改善,對FOS的熱情也愈加高漲,終於和山田在遊戲中正式成為好友。然而,因為她長時間沉迷網遊,讓電腦過度負荷,某天茜的電腦突然爆炸了。

programme.title: 愚蠢天使與惡魔共舞 #11
programme.desc: 莉莉因為被扎維給打傷而哭泣。目睹了這一幕的阿久津,其憤怒達到了巔峰,因而覺醒了惡魔之力。他以壓倒性的力量擊倒扎維,就在他準備給予其致命一擊的瞬間,莉莉擋在了他的面前。然而,阿久津卻因為憤怒而失去了理智,甚至想要攻擊莉莉……!?

programme.title: 愚蠢天使與惡魔共舞 #12
programme.desc: 阿久津在自己的公寓與莉莉亞交談。莉莉亞講述了莉莉的出身以及她拼命建立起來的地位,並與破壞這一切阿久津展開對峙……同時,莉莉在阿久津的床上醒來後,誤以為自己在睡覺時被他給○○了,於是便揮刀砍向阿久津。

programme.title: 海賊王 #22
programme.desc: 為了營救艾斯,白鬍子海賊團與海軍本部、七武海在馬林福特爆發激戰,而魯夫也率領越獄犯加入戰場。魯夫成功救出艾斯,但艾斯卻為了保護他而被赤犬擊殺,白鬍子亦戰死。戰爭最終在紅髮傑克的介入下落幕。經此一戰,魯夫與夥伴們決定分別修行兩年後再會。

programme.desc: 《今日說法》是一檔日播法治欄目,秉持“點滴記錄中國法治進程的理念,以“重在普法,監督執法,促進立法、服務百姓為宗旨,採用“以案說法、大眾參與、專家點評的節目樣式進行普法宣傳,被譽“中國人的法制午餐。節目前半部分呈現記者深入基層採訪的真實案例,後半部分由演播室中的主持人和嘉賓對節目進行點評,體現節目品質和社會價值。

programme.title: 香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
高朋滿座#57粵
programme.desc: 慶與喜到內地旅遊，麗請教朋打理之道，朋說「五勤法」。朋與麗以「五勤法」改正家人廢話過多之陋習，令眾人苦不堪言。眾人商量對抗的方法。到了高慶與妙喜回港當日，看到平時笑口常開的伙計變成直話直說的「機械」。

programme.title: 天龍八部#30粵普PG
programme.desc: 段王爺得知慕容復和王語嫣前去西夏求親，認為段譽一定會去看熱鬧，於是派人送信表示希望段譽能娶到西夏公主。前往西廈的路上，段譽遇見木婉清，二人談話期間，忽然聽到樹林中有人在哭，竟是王語嫣正打算自尋短見…

programme.title: 阿爺廚房粵
programme.desc: 鼎爺、阿譚到澳門，看氹仔地道美食肉切酥的製作方法。再有鼎爺教路揀靚皮蛋，來一鍋「皮蛋鹹瘦肉粥」，如何自家醃鹹肉？「乾炒米粉」正好伴粥，鼎爺先炒香蔬菜再下米粉，炒至乾身又不會黏鍋。二人再往南海西樵，看餅家師傅示範人手造西樵大餅。回香港，鼎爺以三種粉開粉漿，加肉鬆、蝦米等餡料製作「鹹薄罉」，怎樣防止粉漿變稠？接着由阿譚製作甜薄罉麵糰，鼎爺在鑊中推開麵糰，再裹入花生碎、芝麻、椰絲、糖捲起切件，甚考功夫。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 近年學童長期缺課的情況越趨嚴重，精神科醫生指出，學業壓力、校園欺凌等，都可能令小朋友抗拒上學。醫生建議家長留意孩子可有出現焦慮、莫名不適等表徵，也提到為學童提供情感支援時，會先了解其拒學原因才着手協助。坊間盛傳「超級食物」有益健康，但營養師提醒均衡飲食更重要。營養師列舉多種高營養食材，並帶來日常飲食建議，還會細說食物之間的協同作用如何提升營養效益。「睇餸食飯」環節，傅季馨師傅示範「麻辣油甘魚骹」。

programme.title: 一條麻甩在東莞粵
programme.desc: 炒菜裡加香蕉，是暗黑料理嗎？這集祖藍來到麻涌鎮，麻涌的特產就是香蕉，不單止當水果吃，更是一種食材，「全蕉宴」的菜餚可以有多豐盛？祖男還直接登門拜訪臘腸工廠，參觀不同東莞臘腸的製作過程、認識臘腸的不同做法，還享用了一餐臘味盛宴。鎮上還有大學生最愛逛的夜市一條街，除了美食，更有淡淡人情味。

programme.title: 燦爛的外母#9粵
programme.desc: 秀瓊帶司徒嵐及兆明到師姐墳前鞠躬，才應允他們結婚。秀瓊改動兆明家居擺設，跟他約法三章。威龍送曉盈上班時得知麗娟不適，立即趕往護老院。曉盈幫忙照顧麗娟，卻令她受傷。兆明邀請司徒嵐的父親司徒邦出席婚禮，他自覺當年拋妻棄女遂推卻。結婚當日，司徒嵐發現似曾相識的男子，秀瓊也發現此人。秀瓊在酒席後心情低落，威龍帶她到避風塘吃泥鯭粥，指自己當年被拍檔騙財，連太太也跟那人離開，幸得麗娟信任並得秀瓊聘用做司機……

programme.title: 偶像星願7 Third BEAT!粵日
programme.desc: 龍之介與花卷傳出地下情，花卷單方面宣佈轉換公司，令龍之介百口莫辯。三人去見當日在場的凪，凪願意作證，但龍不想拖其他人下水。為免被人惡意製造緋聞，樂表白心意後，表示會跟紡保持距離。

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 這次由兒童體適能教練Yama姐姐引領大家「WORKOUT 2GETHER」。在臀部訓練中，有幾個需要保持姿勢的動作，考驗各人的肌耐力。進行手臂訓練時，教練在部份動作中融入玩樂元素，例如要把水樽丟到地上讓它直立、搖動水樽令樽內產生漩渦，參與的小朋友都玩得很開心。此外，節目會播出AI生成動畫《甲蟲》的下半部。故事中，甲蟲不但遭人捉走，而且被迫隨水飄流，情節驚險刺激。

programme.title: 秘密的偶像公主粵日
programme.desc: 特備節目偶像公主捉迷藏正式開始！艾姆們抓人，偶像公主就要逃到最後，贏取特別的偶像公主卡與演唱會的機會。隨著偶像公主陸續被抓到，目前只剩下陽葵、美月和千依還在逃跑中。到底誰是最終贏家？

programme.title: 財經新聞粵
programme.desc: 緊貼市況，逢交易日下午5時50分報道當日本港和外圍股市行情，以及重點財經新聞。

programme.title: 新聞掏寶粵
programme.desc: 過去香港經歷多次金融風暴，經濟波動，小市民亦難置身事外，理財不善容易陷入破產邊緣，就算收入豐厚的專業人士一樣會陷入財務危機，新聞掏寶和大家重溫2022年專題。

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 尖沙咀某商場外花槽發生火警，疑似商場職員冷靜地使用滅火器幫助撲救，試圖於消防員到場前阻止火勢擴散，其見義勇為舉動獲市民稱讚！節目組也向有關商場查詢起火原因。弟弟指控兄長侵吞財產，多次透過父母要求對方歸還卻不果，涉款逾四千萬？及後父親離世，弟弟接通知要搬離母親名下物業，還控訴兄長趁其不在港，竟搬走父親夾萬，更懷疑兄長與母親打算離港一走了之……隨着年齡增長，眼睛容易出現退化，可有減緩狀況的護眼方法？

programme.title: 黃道益活絡油呈獻：愛． 回家之開心速遞#2767粵
programme.desc: Venus因某些緣故得罪天娥，遂想設法補救；她與路小小、Bonnie偶然發現天娥行蹤，見她與一班太太共聚，似乎正在教授眾人「擺姿勢」。愛盈發現Venus等，提醒眾人切勿多管閒事。小小懷疑天娥正開班教授太太們如何勾引男人，眾人於是暗中調查，卻行藏敗露。愛盈為掩飾天娥「Coupon女皇」身分，遂將錯就錯，承認天娥在教授太太們擺出誘人的「X形姿勢」，藉以留住丈夫。事件本以為就此平息，怎料引發更多麻煩……

programme.title: X Wallet呈獻:臥底嬌娃#19粵PG
programme.desc: 奕風利用佳琪來拒絕妙姿，妙姿傷心。佳琪卻發現對奕風有心動感覺，決定與宗南分手。小茹接到任務要在索帕處放置竊聽器，她幾經掙扎終下定決心，把竊聽器藏於親手縫紉的貓頸圈內，送給露娜。奕風知悉跟劉彪合作的是泰國人察猜。世傑將奕風救走學年一事告知世豪，世豪對奕風起疑；世傑與察猜有交情，提出向他買製毒原材料。小茹不忍索帕被捕，藉故約索帕在交易日子一同旅行，索帕最終不從。索帕帶露娜看獸醫，意外發現隱藏的竊聽器！

programme.title: Funki Finance 呈獻：機智女法醫2#11粵普
programme.desc: 景翊找大夫給楚楚看病，楚楚覺得奇怪，追問之下知道瑾瑜得了疳霉瘡；皇帝得知後也非常震驚，瑾瑜表示他們得的不是疳霉瘡，而是中毒，從沁香等三個的檢查單可以看出分別，瑾瑜覺得案子奇怪，背後應該有更大的陰謀…

programme.title: 宏利保險呈獻：他們的澳洲駕期粵
programme.desc: 踏足南澳純種和牛繁殖基地，四位老友藉舌尖探索滋味秘密，原來當地飼料會加朱古力與糖果？再享用洛貝龍蝦等海鮮，好友分甘同味特別「甜」！來到河海交匯的庫隆，阿蕭與阿廉坐艇體驗收網捕魚，又即興彈奏結他，四人迎着海風頌唱不變友誼。展開動物園冒險之旅，近距離觀賞野生動物，進鐵籠跟籠外獅子玩自拍，夠刺激。乘船暢遊穆理河，再與星空「玩遊戲」，深入國際暗夜保護區觀星。眾人開心唱聚卡啦OK，當然要點唱祥哥「飲歌」。

programme.title: 娛樂頭條粵 及 環球新聞檔案粵
programme.desc: 節目主要以當日的娛樂新聞作重點，讓你瞬間掌握影視娛樂圈動態和最新消息，並以「娛樂大事件」、「搶閘頭條」、「出爐猛料」等為主題作頭條新聞式報道。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 康業信貸快遞呈獻：尋秦記#27粵
programme.desc: 少龍指嫪毐野心勃勃，建議削廷尉總領之權，免他坐大。朱姬游說秦王為琴清立貞節碑，少龍項激烈反對。琴清乘勢追問原因，少龍無言以對。少龍向琴清坦言來自未來，琴清怒責他砌詞拒絕自己。鄒衍覺得少龍所言並非荒誕。朱姬約不韋到寢宮，秦王突然闖入。不韋將事件擺平，但秦王心中有刺，對不韋冷淡。朱姬乘機挑撥，不韋對秦王起了殺機。不韋用以退為進之計，再取得秦王信任。琴清與鄒衍向少龍討教未來天文知識時，驚聞秦王病危。

programme.title: 大玩特玩粵
programme.desc: 以畏高見稱的何浩文，竟與黃美棋來一場攀石爭隊員！吳若希、吳嘉熙首次參與，表現如何？紙巾攻防戰，有人保護紙巾時仍可擺誘人姿勢，亦有人母性大發，竟與對手談判議和！籃球場上的攻防戰，用上人肉籃球架，料不及會演變成一場綜合格鬥，場面一片混亂。講到擲忌廉，場面更難控制！楊潮凱施展最賤本性，美棋無懼高度問題向陳嘉桓連番攻擊，有甚麼事發生令監製忍不住要出聲？兩隊以三人兩手形式的乒乓球賽分勝負，輸家敗在殺球太多。

programme.title: 香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
高朋滿座#58粵
programme.desc: 情遇上劫匪，但溢滿發覺她竟身無分文！高家要眾人自下月預繳家用。有義揭發有情為免高慶與妙喜入錯貨而吵架，老板娘要她自掏腰包購買，有義及溢滿竟代有情辭職。高慶叫來老板娘來到高家攤牌，可是眾人嚇走了老板娘。

programme.title: 天龍八部#31粵普PG
programme.desc: 段正淳欲回大理問清楚傳位一事，可是段延慶忽然出現，把他們一行人都抓走了。李青蘿誤抓了段譽，慕容復便打算跟段延慶交換。為救段譽，刀白鳳讓段延慶知道了段譽是他兒子。慕容復為認段延慶為義父，不惜殺了包不同…

programme.title: 交易現場粵 及 潮流生活誌粵
阿爺廚房粵
programme.desc: 買海鮮迎接豐足新一年！瀨尿蝦如何分雌雄，長頸、短頸瀨尿蝦又有甚麼區別？「椒鹽瀨尿蝦」要夠惹味，切記鼎爺教落烹調貼士。他還豪購大量海鮮自製「海鮮湯泡飯」，原來龍蝦殼及蝦殼是湯底出味精髓！阿譚愛淺嚐酒香，鼎爺善用酒釀與金華火腿的濃味，搭配桂花魚蒸成佳餚。蒸一條硬身及厚身的魚，有何方法更「吸火力」？一頓盛宴必有甜品作結，鼎爺不煮酒釀丸子，再升級煮出「酒釀鵪鶉蛋」糖水，做到一口吃下所有材料，滿足感爆燈！

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 肌肉會隨年紀流失，連同營養不良、缺乏運動等因素，不少長者都容易患上「肌少症」，容易跌倒，也間接減低了抵抗力與心肺功能。老人科專科醫生指出，可透過日常生活困難、體重變更，大約知道此症狀況，再透過適當運動來改善。小腦亦會中風，若不幸發生會影響平衡力與肌肉協調性，物理治療師提出可藉着小腦強化運動而增加相關能力，並即場示範多個訓練動作。「睇餸食飯」環節，Annie選用梅頭肉，奉上惹味菜式「牛油蒜蓉里脊」。

programme.title: 一條麻甩在東莞粵
programme.desc: 這集，祖藍帶大家來到茶山鎮，沉浸式閒逛百年古鎮— 南社古村，參觀謝遇奇家廟，感受歷史痕跡，另會品嚐饒富歷史感的當地美食— 九大簋以及將軍飯。茶山的家常美食當然也不可少，鹹湯丸、芋頭糕還有鬆糕，都是代代傳承的傳統做法。

programme.title: 燦爛的外母#10粵
programme.desc: 曉盈請威龍到餐廳吃飯，期間遇見擔任兼職侍應的佩珊。佩珊求曉盈離開威龍，曉盈坦言未與威龍發展。兆明計劃向銀行貸款買機器，秀瓊反對。銀行因為文件不齊全暫緩借貸，兆明心知秀瓊搞鬼，司徒嵐着兆明遷就秀瓊。兆明提議將清潔、保安和車隊外判；秀瓊反對。秀瓊即將六十歲，司徒嵐提議為她擺壽宴；兆明打算讓員工接受體檢，逾六十歲員工體檢不及格便須退休。秀瓊到街市收數時突然暈倒，雨辰經過並提議送她到醫院，秀瓊匆匆離開……

programme.title: 偶像星願7 Third BEAT!粵日
programme.desc: 凪、樂和三月找上月雲了試圖與他理論，詎料反遭對方挑釁，樂勃然大怒。大和與天約了花卷菫出來見面，但對方已被虎於收買，根本無意說出真相。TRIGGER人氣大受打擊，月雲旗下的偶像團體ZOOL正式登場。

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 這集「Artspiration」的畫作主角是青蛙，其眼睛上卻有角？原來插畫師子健哥哥在家中養了角蛙，並指出角蛙的手指、腳趾都有特點，更可於背景上設計草叢環境。玲玲姐姐學習繪畫的同時，亦趁機提問一些飼養角蛙的注意事項。「開心SHARE」環節，有家庭觀眾分享自己最喜愛的遊戲，引來主持們的共鳴。彤彤姐姐提到曾經熱愛玩拼豆，玲玲姐姐卻聽到一臉問號？Emily姐姐自認數學差，但記性較好，又會玩甚麼遊戲？

programme.title: 秘密的偶像公主粵日
programme.desc: 第四次偶像公主大賽即將開始，然而學生會卻無法進入偶像公主空間，導致Quartet STAR無法參賽。阿櫻於是將今次大賽改為個人賽。面對有機會與美月對決，令陽葵開始擔心，一旦是自己贏了，會否不能再和美月做好朋友……

programme.title: 財經新聞粵
programme.desc: 緊貼市況，逢交易日下午5時50分報道當日本港和外圍股市行情，以及重點財經新聞。

programme.title: 利嘉閣地產45 周年真盤源特約：今日有樓睇粵 及 潮流生活誌粵
programme.desc: 九龍站一個三房，屋主喜歡招呼朋友，設計師如何按生活動線，劃分不同區域？

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 世界觀粵 及 天氣報告粵
東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 黃道益活絡油呈獻：愛． 回家之開心速遞#2768粵
programme.desc: 出於某些理由，樹仁得到一條名為「吃不了」的大魚。大魚要整條清蒸，樹根打算借用Cafe的廚房烹調，敢佳要求一同享用，Andy等人亦要求參與。敢威有意一嚐「吃不了」的滋味，力蓮就「分配事宜」擬訂「妥善」安排，並要求將魚宴延後七天舉行。熊家眾人為照顧「吃不了」而疲於奔命，期間意外發現該魚的秘密！力蓮大事宣揚舉辦魚宴，並計劃進行直播，更邀請國際食評家來品鑑。事情越鬧越大，樹仁決定孤注一擲……

programme.title: X Wallet呈獻:臥底嬌娃#20粵PG
programme.desc: 索帕查出小茹是警察。奕風向喝醉的朱皮坦言關於女友之事，怎料朱皮卻告訴妙姿。妙姿始知一直被奕風欺騙，往找佳琪和小茹評理，佳琪卻叫她不要輕舉妄動。麗荃突然被邦妮解僱，找劉彪訴苦。麗荃找佳琪幫忙偷偷拿回被邦妮收走的公司手機，小茹發現該手機竟與一個泰國號碼互動密切，佳琪留意到奕風對這個號碼似有所隱瞞。圍捕在即，小茹擔心索帕，毒品調查科捉到劉彪、察猜等人。小茹收到索帕相約見面的訊息，宗南派人暗中跟隨……

programme.title: Funki Finance 呈獻：機智女法醫2#12粵普
programme.desc: 謝懷定在出征前吃了一個小孩給的果子，中毒身亡。皇上下旨讓森垚回府治病，森垚偷偷出門找鬼差求藥，景翊尾隨其後抓住了鬼差，此人竟跟周翰長得一模一樣。瑾瑜命冷月從採石場帶回周翰，並讓周翰假扮鬼差，引出同黨…

programme.title: 宏利保險呈獻：他們的澳洲駕期粵
programme.desc: 麥拿倫谷盛產葡萄酒，踩電動單車參觀逾百年酒莊份外寫意，四人還調製心水美酒，計算比例卻鬧出笑話！祥哥藉命名紅酒「放閃」，阿蕭盼留待十八年後才跟妻兒共享。為了慰勞幕後團隊，三兄弟合力煮「大茶飯」，某人原來是被藝人身分耽誤的牛扒大廚？深入克拉倫登的農場，四人親親寵物雞、擁抱高地牛，還化身「奴才」餵牛牛開餐兼梳毛，更意外解鎖「越野車」刺激體驗。在一望無際的海景相伴下，真情互訴兄弟心聲，自駕遊悟出人生道理！

programme.title: 娛樂頭條粵 及 環球新聞檔案粵
programme.desc: 節目主要以當日的娛樂新聞作重點，讓你瞬間掌握影視娛樂圈動態和最新消息，並以「娛樂大事件」、「搶閘頭條」、「出爐猛料」等為主題作頭條新聞式報道。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 天氣報告粵 及 潮流生活誌粵
康業信貸快遞呈獻：尋秦記#28粵
programme.desc: 少龍見秦王口唇及指甲發黑，知他中了慢性毒藥，明白是不韋所為。不韋在病危的秦王面前擁著朱姬，秦王被激死。嬴政終成為秦王，少龍拿著通訊器到山頭，通訊器卻沒電。少龍催促滕翼等翻閱《魯公秘錄》，尋與電或稀硫酸有關的記載卻不果。不韋擬好調配百官的名單，擢升自己人，嬴政沒趣。琴清與鄒衍對少龍說的生電原理全不理解，少龍洩氣。不韋逼嬴政封他為「仲父」，嬴政感委屈。琴清看見閃電劈斷大樹，想到用閃電取電源，少龍興奮。

programme.title: 粵講粵㜺鬼粵
programme.desc: 傳統理髮店買少見少，黃建東與黃耀英「幫襯」逾五十年歷史的「飛髮舖」，順道觀摩鐵風筒、理髮椅等店內生財工具，並暢談「剃頭佬教仔」等歇後語。各式食肆近年紛紛落戶筲箕灣，這個「搵食熱點」昔日曾被稱為「餓人灣」，有何原因？衣著潮流講求「花臣」，吳幸美實地了解洗水牛仔褲的加工過程，竟被取笑「阿婆揄褲」！廣東話保留不少中國昔日用語，「睇」、「舊時」、「隔離」等在古代詩詞已曾出現，大學中文講師廖舜禧逐一講解。

programme.title: 粵講粵㜺鬼粵
programme.desc: 廣東人稱錢包為「荷包」，「肇慶荷包」卻是罵人的歇後語？手袋設計師把傳統華麗的舊裙褂，改造成時款手袋，創意可謂「帽子爛了邊－ 頂好」！嘉賓張惠雅還與主持們「扮鬼扮馬」，了解造花牌這門逐漸失傳的巧手工藝。「入得廚房，出得廳堂」向來是賢淑女生的形容詞，上世紀四十、五十年代，一碗魚蛋粉竟是理想「人妻」指標？「縮沙」、「淆底」跟《易經》又有甚麼關連？歷史專家鄭寶鴻與大學中文講師廖舜禧逐一拆解。

programme.title: 香港早晨粵 及 環球新聞檔案粵
隆行天下之重走八千里路雲和月普
手匠傳承粵韓
programme.desc: 阿曼彎刀, 一種阿曼傳統表演-阿爾拉茲法的重要配飾 彎刀是阿曼珍貴的文化遺產, 象徵住阿曼的歷史和身份, 甚至於國家徽章都能看到其踪影 本集將介紹阿曼彎刀的製作過程及傳統意義

programme.title: 翻生工程粵英
programme.desc: 工程師Rob Bell帶大家探討將廢棄結構轉變為未來建築背後的重大挑戰。

programme.title: 仨心友行粵
programme.desc: 停泊島海水清澈，為海洋生物提供優美的生長環境。三位美女與楊明大玩浮潛，欣賞七彩繽紛的海底世界，倍覺身心舒暢。夜幕低垂，四人坐在沙灘旁把酒談心，凱琳回想大學時期曾受情緒問題困擾；高Ling亦訴說入行初期因負面新聞陷入困局。楊明憶起傷心往事，更不禁流下男兒淚！翌日天朗氣清，又是時候玩遊戲。四人暢玩獨木舟後，挑戰真心話大冒險。敏之大方公開性幻想對象，高Ling更當眾「瀨敏之鞋底」！楊明又何以滿面奶油？

programme.title: 港產旅行團粵
programme.desc: 衍峰、淑雅遷就山系新手穎彤，揀選從山頂廣場出發的貼地郊遊路線，輕鬆滿足行山欲望。登上西高山頂觀賞港島南區，以及西九龍一帶的「豪宅」景色，大地在我腳下！嘉賓楊潮凱帶淑雅到上環元創方，穿梭藝術基地，最適合拍攝文青風唯美照片。祖儀、淑雅閨密宅度假，吃吃高空Tea、浸浸啤酒Spa，還結伴學習調酒，有姊妹像個寶！穎彤、祖儀隨導遊開展經典電影朝聖團，遊走重慶大廈、廣東道以至半島酒店，探索多齣影片取景之地。

programme.title: 周六聊Teen谷粵
programme.desc: 高比．拜仁是傳奇籃球明星，卻於2020年因直升機意外離世，眾谷主希望透過這集，述說這位偉大球員的一生。高比高中畢業後便毅然輟學投身NBA，新秀賽季雖遭遇挫敗，他卻以瘋狂訓練迎難而上。凱文細述高比在賽場上的輝煌成就，以及如何克服傷患、堅持不懈訓練，還提到他退役時撰寫的「致籃球告白信」。高比的人生故事深深觸動三位谷主，啟發瀅仴要活在當下，並反思自己加入演藝事業的初心；汛文也從中體會到定立目標的重要。

programme.title: 警聲百二秒 III粵
programme.desc: 「警聲百二秒」系列再次歸來，《警聲百二秒 III》由警方代表聯同眾多藝員參與演出，會繼續透過有趣的故事情節，介紹香港警務處更多部門的工作、更多防罪訊息，讓廣大市民可輕鬆「全方位」了解警隊更多資訊。

programme.title: 一路前行粵普
programme.desc: 一部聚焦中國生態保護，綠色高品質發展的環保公益紀實節目。透過沉浸式觀察新時代環保議題，並邀請胡歌、劉濤、陳龍三位明星親身參與，共同完成一場綠色低碳生活的行動。

programme.title: 成人教科書粵
programme.desc: 香港近年成為全球最長壽地區，幾位十歲出頭的孩子又希望活到多少歲？在節目組和洪永城安排下，小朋友分成兩組，第一組到學校，向校長及負責老師了解校內如何推行生死教育，並共同飼養一條「寵物魚」。第二組前往山野接受求生技巧訓練，掌握搭建帳篷後，一試野外捉魚並隨即動刀劏魚。活動尾聲，兩組人都有一條魚作「食物報酬」，為何一邊感到雀躍，另一邊卻愁雲慘霧？養魚組別當知道眼前蒸魚並非所養的寵物魚，心情和胃口大為轉變！

programme.title: 地球大神秘粵
programme.desc: 今年是人類充滿惶恐不安的一年，網絡上流傳不少大災難的預言：中東戰火、日本超級大地震等，我們的明天究竟會怎樣呢？很多人想預知未來，研究它的真假，在網絡資訊爆炸的時代，越講越真，越知道反而越驚，就好像聖經一早預言：『人想起將要臨到世界的事，就嚇得魂不附體』這一刻，站在文明懸崖上的我們，是否正要見證這古老預言成為現實？在全新一輯的地球大神秘，我們會繼續從世界各地神秘事件，探討各種預言的真確，還會同被稱為最準確重要的預言書《聖經》作對比，在末世中得到真正的平安保障。

programme.title: 新幹線戰士 改變世界粵日
programme.desc: 伊奈的帳戶再次被登入，太晴跟高輪與阿賀野分享伊奈的往事。H5的駕駛員覓得人選，對方叫五稜郭紫苑，由於人在函館，故透過元宇宙與大家見面。紫苑透露有關戀愛的煩惱，舞與比娜聽見後大為雀躍。

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 三位小朋友來到「WORKOUT 2GETHER」，首先隨教練Yama姐姐進行臀部訓練。動作大多需要持續來做，考驗肌耐力。有小朋友左右跳時感到疲累，想停下來，但於教練鼓勵下仍堅持完成，精神值得嘉許。稍後的腿部強化訓練，只需側躺伸腿即可，較簡單卻有效，大家表現如何？「動物好萌友」環節有唐狗「琑琑」登場，牠會引領觀眾外出散步，並與朋友仔嬉玩，展現活潑可愛的一面。

programme.title: 查查林部隊粵英
programme.desc: 森林裡神秘怪事頻生。巨大陷阱出現，栗子消失，昆蟲失蹤，橡實從天而降！要交由大偵探Peet和朋友Baba和Molly組成的查查林部隊調查。牠們未必是最能幹的偵探隊，但往往能夠迎刃而解，揭開大自然奧秘。

programme.title: 查查林部隊粵英
programme.desc: 森林裡神秘怪事頻生。巨大陷阱出現，栗子消失，昆蟲失蹤，橡實從天而降！要交由大偵探Peet和朋友Baba和Molly組成的查查林部隊調查。牠們未必是最能幹的偵探隊，但往往能夠迎刃而解，揭開大自然奧秘。

programme.title: 櫻桃小丸子粵日
programme.desc: 小丸子連續兩天被人問路，原本以為是巧合，但長山同學對此事有不同的見解。小丸子與家人分吃蛋糕之後，因為覺得意猶未盡，於是說想試一次，獨自吃全個完整的蛋糕，卻遭到家人潑冷水。

programme.title: 潛行天下粵
programme.desc: 《潛行天下》以全球海洋為主題，採用8K超高清攝影機和水下無人機等技術建構沉浸式觀影體驗，跨越四大洋14國水域拍攝，記錄雙髻鯊、鯨鯊等海洋生物活動，探密三沙永樂龍洞等特殊地形。

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 新聞透視粵
programme.desc: 本台發現多區都有針對內地來港學生的中學生宿舍，一個床位月租高達16,000元，需求有多大？有二房東租下單位，改裝學生宿舍出租，一個月收租高達12萬，但原來不用申領牌照，法例是否存有灰色地帶？隨著來港讀書的內地學生增加，中學生宿舍需求上升，本港如何檢視相關配套？

programme.title: 好嘢港多啲粵
programme.desc: 香港特區政府帶領各個部門及單位，適時推出不同的政策措施，為本港市民、到訪旅客、來自外地的投資者提供便捷服務。香港這麼好，當然要多說一些讓大家知道。《好嘢港多啲》以輕鬆有趣的拍攝手法，配合陳豪、高海寧、張振朗、劉佩玥、周嘉洛、羅子溢、馬國明、陳懿德、陳展鵬、劉穎鏇等一眾星級藝員，透過不同角色、形象，生動地表達香港的各樣美好和優勢。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 渣打優先私人理財呈獻：Grand住享樂人生粵
programme.desc: 堪輿學家蘇民峰藉旅遊增廣見聞，從窮遊玩到每個月度假，實行邊學邊玩享樂人生！蘇師傅還細談北極格陵蘭、法國滑雪奢華旅程點滴。西式食材結合中式烹飪手法，名廚李文星將中菜廳帶到世界舞台，並親自巡視多地分店，對品質有堅持！闖進超跑收藏家基地，一探其投資心得，高Ling還獲邀坐上超跑遊車河，感受車迷狂熱。「世一」酒吧開業三年就登頂，有何成功之道？高Ling約同陳曉華酒聚交流，各自分享利物浦之行、超級遊艇體驗。

programme.title: 博愛歡樂傳萬家粵
programme.desc: 梁漢文以<艦隊、<七友打頭陣，為籌款晚會拉開序幕。鍾鎮濤帶來<誠懇與<讓我坦蕩蕩、車婉婉訴說<遲來的加冕、林曉培演繹<心動，樂迷期待。多個音樂單位的聯動亦受注目，如周國賢與樂隊ToNick的搖滾組合，鍾舒漫率「聲秀」學員的女團舞曲。還有胡鴻鈞夥戴祖儀、馮熙燮跟鄧小巧的男女合唱、冼靖峰與胡子貝的男男對唱、黃妍偕柯雨霏的女生版獻聲。太極樂隊壓軸登場，帶來<紅色跑車、<留住我吧等曲目。

programme.title: 伯樂音樂學院20週年呈獻：J Music粵
programme.desc: 這集為《J Music》濃縮版，會倒數本星期「勁歌金榜」二十首上榜歌曲的排名位置，並相約馬來西亞歌手盧信宥(Ash)暢談音樂。

programme.title: J Sport粵
programme.desc: 學界足球精英賽決賽，拔萃男書院以2比1挫聖若瑟書院，締造三連霸！甲一籃球總決賽第四場，香港東方力求再下一城封王，滿貫又能否絕地反擊扳平戰局？藝人林慧倩細談情迷MMA的緣由，並希望推動更多女生參與這項搏擊運動。定向挑戰賽設不同線上線下任務，這集一探中學生隊伍的參賽感受。各界集結愛心跑，同心推廣運動樂趣。優秀運動員計劃向殘特奧會得獎港將頒發獎金；另送上三鐵亞錦賽戰報，以及場地單車世界盃香港站記招花絮。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵 及 天氣報告粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 財經透視粵
programme.desc: 近期全城掀起下載AI代理的熱潮，市面的高階電腦和配件也變得熱賣，情況如何？去年香港新股市場集資額，重奪全球首位，今年的形勢會如何？

programme.title: 叠影狙擊#9粵PG
programme.desc: 晟杰根據線人的情報，讓飛飛聯絡教授的中間人；因為曉晨的出現，霆釗到新加坡，向黑幫買兇殺曉晨；梁伯致電曉晨，說謀財害命的人來到安老院，曉晨立即趕到，遇見曾經跟梁曦有過節的Coco，曉晨懷疑她與梁曦的死有關…

programme.title: 東張西望粵

programme.title: 仨心友行粵
programme.desc: 停泊島海水清澈，為海洋生物提供優美的生長環境。三位美女與楊明大玩浮潛，欣賞七彩繽紛的海底世界，倍覺身心舒暢。夜幕低垂，四人坐在沙灘旁把酒談心，凱琳回想大學時期曾受情緒問題困擾；高Ling亦訴說入行初期因負面新聞陷入困局。楊明憶起傷心往事，更不禁流下男兒淚！翌日天朗氣清，又是時候玩遊戲。四人暢玩獨木舟後，挑戰真心話大冒險。敏之大方公開性幻想對象，高Ling更當眾「瀨敏之鞋底」！楊明又何以滿面奶油？

programme.title: 成人教科書粵
programme.desc: 節目組讓小朋友寫兩封信，一封是給或將誕生的弟妹，另一封是自己的遺書。眾人都抱着愉快心情迎接新生命，對離世之事傷感。百日宴和喪禮，是生與死的兩樁人生大事，在籌辦過程中卻有不少相似的地方；洪永城帶孩子們作進一步認識。有男生親自體驗躺棺木、遺體化妝，感受如何？及後他為參加百日宴變妝，妝容會有甚麼不同？再探索二者的場地佈置，小朋友對選擇棺木、陪葬品各有想法；也會嘗試為百日宴製作氣球橋，及為喪禮預備棺面花。

programme.title: 手匠傳承粵韓
programme.desc: 阿曼彎刀, 一種阿曼傳統表演-阿爾拉茲法的重要配飾 彎刀是阿曼珍貴的文化遺產, 象徵住阿曼的歷史和身份, 甚至於國家徽章都能看到其踪影 本集將介紹阿曼彎刀的製作過程及傳統意義

programme.desc: 豬豬俠與同伴接收到來自九霄星的求救信號，儘管他們已經失去了強大的超能力，但熱心腸的豬豬們仍然義無反顧地再次啓航，前往那個充滿未知數的陌生星球。來到九霄星後，豬豬們看到了整個星球的地表都被灼熱的岩漿覆蓋，而空中竟然懸浮着許多壯觀宏大、各具特色的天空之城。但是，這些天空之城正在陸續失去能讓它們懸浮的五靈元素，面臨墜毀的威脅。豬豬俠等人尋找背後的原因，並耍起功夫，抵抗反派邪惡力量，使出渾身解數拯救天空之城。一場守護正義、保護天空之城的全新冒險之旅開始啦。

programme.title: 海鸚歷險記

programme.title: 豬豬俠之超星五靈俠S4
programme.desc: 豬豬俠與同伴接收到來自九霄星的求救信號，儘管他們已經失去了強大的超能力，但熱心腸的豬豬們仍然義無反顧地再次啓航，前往那個充滿未知數的陌生星球。來到九霄星後，豬豬們看到了整個星球的地表都被灼熱的岩漿覆蓋，而空中竟然懸浮着許多壯觀宏大、各具特色的天空之城。但是，這些天空之城正在陸續失去能讓它們懸浮的五靈元素，面臨墜毀的威脅。豬豬俠等人尋找背後的原因，並耍起功夫，抵抗反派邪惡力量，使出渾身解數拯救天空之城。一場守護正義、保護天空之城的全新冒險之旅開始啦。

programme.title: 檢索愛情
programme.desc: 【林秀晶X張基龍大談姐弟戀年下男狂撩職場女強人】聚焦於三位35歲女性——裴朵美、車賢和宋佳景，她們在職場和感情中勇敢追夢。這三位獨立的女性，專注於自己的事業，成為職場上的佼佼者。然而在她們堅強的外表下，深藏著對愛情的渴望。儘管在追求夢想的道路上充滿坎坷，她們依然堅信自己的抉擇。在她們身後都有一位，用自己的方式默默守護的真命天子，以現實的筆觸描繪了這三個女性在職場上的競爭和情感中的糾結，將粉紅泡泡與現實的辛酸完美結合。

programme.title: 奶酪陷阱
programme.desc: 【金高銀與朴海鎮領銜，知名主角群展現校園青春浪漫！！】大學新生洪雪面對完美又腹黑的劉正學長，因獨特魅力逐漸受他吸引。隨著兩人情意漸濃，劉正的神秘性個性和控制慾逐漸浮出水面，兩人微妙的心理戰，以及性格不羈同學的白仁浩再洪雪身邊守候，三人的矛盾、最終洪雪情歸何處?

programme.title: 暖陽之下
programme.desc: 【溫馨陸劇/二寶＆事業該選誰？ 都市夫妻的兩難抉擇！】宋思凝懷著夢想隻身來到北京，經過多年打拼終於成為公司的人力總監，與創意公司總經理李俊龍成為夫妻，並育有一兒，日子過得幸福美滿。但在婚育觀上，兩人的想法有極大的分歧，經常為了女兒的教育問題爭吵，李俊龍希望能與思凝生育二寶，然而正值事業上升期的思凝，面臨自我實現與家庭的兩難衝突，在大都會生活的兩人又該如何抉擇呢？

programme.title: 只屬於我的你
programme.desc: 【渣男律師劈腿富豪千金李敏英逆襲成知名設計師】恩靜與律師姜勝宰結婚後，原以為會享受奢華生活，但現實卻是在婆家被當成傭人使喚。婆婆因恩靜沒有家世而感到丟臉，勝宰也漸漸冷淡，甚至不願承認老婆。事實上，恩靜發現勝宰根本沒有辦理結婚登記，當她為了幫助妹妹處理財務問題，辦理貸款時才揭露了這個真相。不久後她發現老公與BJ集團繼承人有染，決心離開傷心地，重返職場成為知名設計師。與此同時，昔日男友俊夏重新進入她的生活，默默支持她，希望能給她真正的幸福。

programme.title: 吹吧微風
programme.desc: 【千億遺產考驗林智妍淪落魄千金竟遭林秀香假冒身分】一場跨越南北的失散命運，意外揭開千億財產背後的血緣騙局。脫北女孩微風重返南韓，與多年不見的初戀律師長高重逢，卻被捲入豪門爭產與身世之謎。冒名孫女設局奪產，謊言層層堆疊，親情逐漸崩裂；長高的母親強勢介入，以門第與前途逼迫兒子放棄真愛。當真相一一曝光，有人為貪念付出慘痛代價，有人失去一切。被犧牲的愛情，是否還能在命運翻轉後，迎來真正的團圓？

programme.title: 奔跑吧薔薇
programme.desc: 【紈褲子弟情留落難千金，尋覓守護愛情的甜蜜配方】過著豐食無缺沒有大小姐架子的薔薇。一場家中巨變，面臨相親結婚丈夫的背叛，經濟困境及失去原生家庭的後盾。困境中憑著對料理的熱情及新生活，與食品公司會長的孫子相戀，奔向對方的路上還會遇上什麼樣的考驗?

programme.title: 現在開始是Showtime！
programme.desc: 【操縱幻術的魔術師朴海鎮×通靈女警秦基周，靈異喜劇Showtime！！】神秘又搞怪的魔術師車次雄，不僅能操縱幻術，還能使喚鬼魂，這群「幽靈助手」是他的得力夥伴。熱血女警高瑟海，擁有通靈能力，她對靈異現象毫不畏懼。兩人因一起調查超自然案件而結盟，一邊與鬼神合作，一邊大展魔術與正義力量。當喜劇、靈異與調查結合，愛情與真相也心動牽引。

programme.title: 落花時節又逢君
programme.desc: 【小花妖胡意旋強撩告白高冷花神劉學義，大談反差萌戀！！】不懂情愛、呆萌率直的小花妖紅凝，為了報恩誤闖仙界，卻意外發現自己口中的「仙女姐姐」，竟是身為花神的錦繡。紅凝大膽示愛，直言想當錦繡的「天后」，不是拉著他一起睡覺就是要陪他洗澡，讓這位必須斷情絕愛、恪守仙妖界限的未來天帝繼承者瞬間亂了方寸。

programme.title: 極速悖論
programme.desc: 【超越速度的愛情故事，不只想見柯佳嬿，合作《覆流年》翟子路，賽車場上大談13歲差姊弟戀！！】從小將賽車作為夢想的陳墨白，最大目標就是登上超級方程式賽場。碰上了貴為空氣動力學工程師的沈溪，卻隱身為辦公室的打雜小妹。彼此成為重要的陪伴，賽車場上超越速度也突破兩人心魔，共同為了夢想努力。

programme.title: 現在開始是Showtime！(完)
programme.desc: 【操縱幻術的魔術師朴海鎮×通靈女警秦基周，靈異喜劇Showtime！！】神秘又搞怪的魔術師車次雄，不僅能操縱幻術，還能使喚鬼魂，這群「幽靈助手」是他的得力夥伴。熱血女警高瑟海，擁有通靈能力，她對靈異現象毫不畏懼。兩人因一起調查超自然案件而結盟，一邊與鬼神合作，一邊大展魔術與正義力量。當喜劇、靈異與調查結合，愛情與真相也心動牽引。

programme.title: 異想天開木瓜島
programme.desc: 歡迎來到木瓜島！這是一個與世隔絕的地方，有著獨特又古怪的傳統，木瓜島的每個孩子都有小牛看護者，除了一個不知怎麼來到島上的孩子－－卡庫佩，經過種種努力，終於得到一隻神經質的小牛蘇格拉底。而這對特別的搭檔，將會挑戰木瓜島的傳統……

programme.title: 紳士與小姐
programme.desc: 【韓國收視破38%韓版《真善美》重拾幸福時光】《我唯一的守護者》編劇金始慶最新家庭劇新作，與爸爸、繼母一同生活的直率女孩朴丹丹，因繼兄繼母闖禍被詐騙，使得原本不富裕的家庭更加困苦，面對爸爸的偏坦對待，朴丹丹憤而離家，因緣際會下來到有錢人家擔任住宿教師，陪伴失去母親的三個孩子，而他們的爸爸便是高冷霸道總裁李英國，在妻子早逝後，英國的內心漸漸封閉，與孩子間也產生隔閡，好在天真浪漫的朴丹丹出現，加上孩子們的湊合，幸福將再次降臨。

programme.title: 家宴
programme.desc: 【離家追夢，還是回家團圓？馮家菜北漂生存戰】馮家菜是北京頗具名氣的淮揚菜館，女強人大米憑藉一身拼勁，將小館打造成金字招牌，卻因妹夫欠債，陷入食品安全風波，生意一落千丈。為救餐館，她請出退休父親參賽，奪得全國冠軍，卻招來資本大鱷周路的覬覦。親情與利益交織，事業與愛情碰撞，兄妹間信任破裂，馮家菜面臨生死存亡。當大米病倒，家庭崩解，弟弟豆子終於悔悟，全家攜手重建家業。當揚州炒飯再次上桌，家的味道，未曾改變。

programme.title: 生活家
programme.desc: 【金馬演員攜手演出破產母女生存記】少見的審計職場劇，樂觀正向，帶給人心激勵。從小在拮据家庭成長的邱冬娜，在課業工作上總是特別勤奮，希望透過自己的努力讓母親過上好生活。畢業後，因緣際會下進入了前輩顧飛開的審計稽核公司，面對孤僻但能力強的主管顧飛，邱冬娜雖然頭痛但絕不認輸！運用從母親身上學到的智慧，還有艱困生活帶給她的精打細算體質，邱冬娜總能屢出奇招化解艱難任務。曾有心理創傷的主管顧飛，也在邱冬娜的陪伴下，兩人亦師亦友,相互扶持鼓勵，逐漸治癒傷口，成為彼此的靈魂伴侶。

programme.title: 兩個女人的房間
programme.desc: 【慘遭閨蜜心機暗算朴恩惠由飯店繼承人淪為女僕】在瑞士留學歸來後，晴彩充滿自信地踏入了蒙娜麗莎飯店，端莊秀麗的外表和聰穎的頭腦，讓她很快成為了飯店的副社長兼繼承人。與同飯店的總經理志燮之間的戀情，更是讓她的生活充滿了甜蜜和期待。一場車禍意外將掀起腥風血雨，當晴彩以為自己撞死了熙秀的養父時，內心充滿了恐懼與內疚感，在晴彩的堅持下，熙秀搬進了她的家，開始了新的生活。從那時起，晴彩心愛的人和她的一切都逐漸被熙秀所奪走，包括飯店的地位和財富，晴彩更是從繼承人淪為女僕，為了奪回曾經的一切，晴彩將對熙秀展開復仇。

programme.title: 名人初乃玩
programme.desc: 最接地氣的外景行腳節目,由名人帶領網路紅人到店家體驗吃、喝、玩、樂。寓教於樂，帶給觀眾耳目一新的超強體驗。

programme.title: 紳士與小姐
programme.desc: 【韓國收視破38%韓版《真善美》重拾幸福時光】《我唯一的守護者》編劇金始慶最新家庭劇新作，與爸爸、繼母一同生活的直率女孩朴丹丹，因繼兄繼母闖禍被詐騙，使得原本不富裕的家庭更加困苦，面對爸爸的偏坦對待，朴丹丹憤而離家，因緣際會下來到有錢人家擔任住宿教師，陪伴失去母親的三個孩子，而他們的爸爸便是高冷霸道總裁李英國，在妻子早逝後，英國的內心漸漸封閉，與孩子間也產生隔閡，好在天真浪漫的朴丹丹出現，加上孩子們的湊合，幸福將再次降臨。

programme.title: 我的野蠻王妃
programme.desc: 【神級經典韓劇，尹恩惠、朱智勳、金楨勳、宋智孝再現現代宮廷指腹為婚！！】申采靜原本只是一名平凡無奇的高中學生，得知爺爺的遺囑中，她與皇太子李信有婚約在身。因家中債務的原因，在無可奈何的情況完婚。待在皇室的申采靜對宮內生活十分反彈，此時海歸回來的皇位第二繼承者李律及李信前女友閔孝琳的存在，展開錯綜複雜的故事。

programme.title: 另一種藍
programme.desc: 【宋茜邂逅周渝民，事業失意返鄉傳承青花瓷再現風華！！】北漂少女陳小滿努力工作、省吃儉用為求入股家族瓷器事業，卻以失敗收場，毅然決然回景德鎮專心學習瓷器工藝。陳小滿工作的上司柯巖則在投資上遭遇前所未有的失利，輾轉來到景德鎮。處於低潮的兩人在互相治癒中重新找回站起來的力量，事業重新起步，愛情也開始萌芽。

programme.title: 裝腔啟示錄
programme.desc: 初級律師唐影在上海紅圈律所工作，意外結識了合作方許子詮。雖然二人暗生情愫，卻始終沒有勇氣直面真實的情感。兩人歷經多次事件，最終在唐影的幫助下，許子詮驅散了多年陰影，敢於直面情感不再逃避，而唐影也在許子詮的信任和陪伴下，接受了自己最真實的一面。

programme.title: 六龍飛天
programme.desc: 李成桂為了正式的投身政治啓程去往開京，李芳遠也跟隨着父親去了開京。來到開京的李芳遠看到了置百姓死活於不顧只為自己填飽肚子的權文勢族，無法抑制住自己內心的憤怒。原本就對於李成桂的政界出仕很警惕的李仁謙將李成桂邀請到自己家裏並舉辦了宴會，在宴會上李仁謙給他看了以他背叛了曾經像兄弟一樣的趙小生為題材的街頭劇。在宴會結束後李成桂為了讓李仁謙保守自己背叛趙末生的秘密，向李仁謙低下了頭，李芳遠目擊到了這一幕。

programme.title: 少年時代
programme.desc: 【電影《原本以為只是手機掉了》任時完，大反派變小可憐少年，勇往直前成為校園新老大！！】出生忠清南道的瘦小懦弱高中生張秉泰，以「在學校不挨打」為最大目標。某天因父親意外的關係，連夜逃到隔壁村，轉學至扶餘農高竟搖身一變成為學校老大，親身體驗強者生存的熱血故事。

programme.title: The Vanishing Soldier

programme.title: The Traveller: The Temptation of Evil

programme.desc: Enersto, a hunting guide in Patagonia, is left to take care of his teenage son he hasn’t seen for years. An intense father-son relationship is played out amidst the hostility of nature.

programme.title: éeTokyo Fianc
programme.desc: A charming and tender tale of young love and cultural discovery. Amélie, a Japanophile young Belgian woman in Tokyo falls into a whirlwind romance with Rinri, a Francophile Japanese student.

programme.title: Submission
programme.desc: Lúcia is raped by her husband and presses charges against him. In her quest for justice, she must battle her husband who is the son of the State's Vice Attorney, and the Portuguese legal system with its patriarchal beliefs.

programme.title: The Daval Mystery
programme.desc: Jonathann Daval reports the disappearance of his wife Alexia after she fails to return from her morning jog. Over the next three months, the police will launch the most relentless investigation into a media saga that will shake the whole of France.

programme.title: Falling Into Place
programme.desc: Kira and Ian meet all too briefly over a winter weekend on the Isle of Skye and form a sudden and deep bond. Back in London, they try to move on with their separate lives - but both have to stop running from themselves before they are ready to meet again.

programme.title: Victoria Must Go
programme.desc: Hedvig and Henrik's new stepmother Victoria is annoying and constantly introducing new rules. They decide to hire a hitman to get rid of her, and end up persuading a very reluctant immigrant, Carl, to do the job.

programme.title: They Say Nothing Stays The Same
programme.desc: Toichi, a solitary river boatman, watches his quiet world shift as a bridge across the river threatens to upend his livelihood. When he takes in a mysterious young girl with nowhere to go, her presence leads him toward unexpected change.

programme.title: Train Driver's Diary
programme.desc: As Ilija nears retirement, his record of unintentional deaths as a train driver weighs heavy. His adopted son, Sima, fears following in his footsteps. But as days pass without incident, Ilija's determination to ensure Sima's success takes a dark turn.

programme.title: – The Line of FireEl Alamein

programme.title: Impermanence
programme.desc: The film tells the stories of different people and how they are intertwined surrounding the gruesome death of a man who got thrown out of a window.

programme.title: Time For Love

programme.title: A Tale of Samurai Cooking - A True Love Story
programme.desc: Great cook Haru has married into the legendary “Kitchen Samurai” family. But her husband who is the successor of the Funaki family cannot cook at all. Haru makes a vow to make him a superb samurai chef and starts teaching her new husband how to cook.

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops (S1) - UFO

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Family Meeting
programme.desc: When Dad's accused of fluffing in Bluey's face as he climbed out of bed, he's put on trial with Mum as the judge, and Bluey and Bingo as witnesses. Bluey might also have to explain what she was doing there.

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Whale Watching
programme.desc: Bluey promises her customer, Bingo, the best tour ever in a game of Whale Watching, but they need Mum and Dad to join in, and they are too tired to play after a late night.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S5) - The Metal Detector Badge
programme.desc: Roly needs a wee, but the door is locked and Duggee has mislaid the key. Not to worry, Duggee has his metal detector.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S5) - The Diary Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels find a dusty, old book behind a cupboard... it's Duggee's diary from when he was a teenager! The Squirrels are keen to write diaries of their own.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club (S1) - Squirrel Babies
programme.desc: Spring has sprung! There are cute baby animals to meet and frolic with.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club (S1) - Ladybird's Gameshow
programme.desc: Spot the odd one out or guess who lives here. A great memory tip from Duggee, an edition of The Agony and Eggstacy, and how to draw Enid - down to her last whisker.

programme.title: Go Jetters (S3) - Hollywood, USA
programme.desc: Glitch is not happy when he has to work with Kyan in a Hollywood film.

programme.title: Bluey (S1) - Blue Mountains
programme.desc: Bluey, Bingo, Mum and Dad play a game of hand puppets, exploring the land beyond the Blue Mountains where they outsmart the Cheeky Fox to find the softest ever beds.

programme.title: Bluey (S2) - Flatpack
programme.desc: While Mum and Dad struggle to build new flat-pack furniture, Bluey and Bingo transform the empty boxes into their own new world.

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Smoochy Kiss
programme.desc: Bluey and Bingo want Dad all to themselves and will not let Mum have a smoochy kiss. They try to hide him all around the house, but Mum is desperate to spend a little romance time with her husband.

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Dirt
programme.desc: Judo desperately wants to play in the dirt with Bluey and Bingo, but she is not supposed to get herself dirty.

programme.title: Andy's Aquatic Adventures (S1) - Andy and the Glass Frog
programme.desc: Andy heads to Costa Rica to find out how frogspawn survives in the wild.

programme.title: Playtime Towers (S1) - Mud
programme.desc: Bella and Lift visit the Cloud Kitchen, where Patch is busy with the Playtimers making a tasty treat called Munchy Muddy Meadows.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S4) - The Dos and Don'ts Badge

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S4) - The Exercise Badge

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S4) - The Music Video Badge

programme.title: Go Jetters (S2) - Avenue of the Baobabs, Madagascar
programme.desc: GrimHQ crashes into the Baobab trees. Can the Go Jetters rescue a baby lemur in time?

programme.title: Go Jetters (S2) - Machu Picchu, Peru
programme.desc: A giant grimbot bounces down the valley of Machu Picchu. Can the Go Jetters stop him?

programme.desc: Gordon and Rebecca do the same work, but go about it differently, and when Rebecca tries to be more like Gordon, it doesn't go well.

programme.title: Sarah and Duck (S3) - Brolly Bus
programme.desc: When Umbrella gets left on the bus, Sarah and Duck head to the bus depot in search of their friend.

programme.title: Sarah and Duck (S3) - Park Trimming
programme.desc: Sarah &amp;amp; Duck do a spot of gardening.

programme.title: Stan Can (S1) - Knitting
programme.desc: Stanley must teach his friends how to knit. They all knit so much they burst out the top of the community centre. Stanley repairs the roof with the groups knitting.

programme.title: Stan Can (S1) - Runaway Train
programme.desc: Stanley must deliver some parcels on the train but ends up delivering the wrong ones. After correcting his mistake, he has to muster the townsfolk to help stop his runaway train.

programme.title: Number 1 Newton Avenue (S1) - Wrong Way
programme.desc: Libby has made a mini golf course out of cardboard in the shared garden. Libby tries to instruct her Mum on how to navigate the course but ends up confusing herself.

programme.title: JoJo &amp; Gran Gran (S3) - It's Time to Make Jewellery
programme.desc: JoJo loves Gran Gran's jewellery, especially the brooch from Great-Gran Gran. She's also excited to make her own special treasures, just like Captain Chloe.

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Rain

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Pizza Girls
programme.desc: Bluey and Bingo make mud pizzas and deliver them to the grown-ups, but their pedal car's wheel keeps falling off.

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Driving

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S2) - The Memory Badge
programme.desc: Happy discovers his wobbly tooth has come out, but he's lost it! He's having a problem remembering where he was when it fell out.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S2) - The Theatre Badge
programme.desc: Duggee and the squirrels help to put on an amateur dramatic show.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club (S1) - Hey Quacky!
programme.desc: Worm and Ladybird wonder what's going on at Squirrel Club. There's a gorilla playing drums, some helpful ducks, a hot frog, four goats and a hospital run by chicken doctors.

programme.title: Go Jetters (S2) - Kinderdijk, Netherlands

programme.title: Roots &amp; Fruits (S1) - Raspberry

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops (S1) - Runaway Tour
programme.desc: Preston's automated scooter tour of Swoppiton doesn't go as planned. Mojo and Bo must find a way to chase down and scoop up those scooters, and get the tour back on track!

programme.title: JoJo & Gran Gran (S1) - It's time to grow a flower
programme.desc: JoJo tries to grow a daffodil but is disheartened to learn that it will take a long time to bloom. Cynthia and Gran Gran show JoJo how to take care of it and the best way to measure its growth.

programme.title: JoJo & Gran Gran (S1) - It's time to make up a story
programme.desc: When JoJo can't find her favourite Captain Chloe storybook, Gran Gran suggests they make up their own story.

programme.title: Sarah and Duck (S3) - Constable Quack
programme.desc: After their snacks go missing, Sergeant Sarah &amp; Constable Quack are on the trail of a biscuit burglar.

programme.title: Sarah and Duck (S3) - Arcade Dance Off
programme.desc: Stumbling across an arcade, Sarah takes on a dancing challenge with John, whilst Duck and Flamingo team up to try and defeat a video game!

programme.title: Thomas & Friends (S24) - Thomas' Animal Friends
programme.desc: Thomas is asked to help at the animal park for the day and realizes that it also involves being decorated as a monkey.

programme.title: Bluey (S1) - Takeaway
programme.desc: Forced to wait five minutes in front of a restaurant for their takeaway, Bluey and Bingo become restless for entertainment, pushing the very limits of Dad's patience.

programme.title: Bluey (S1) - Butterflies
programme.desc: Playing 'Butterflies' in the backyard is great fun, until Bluey runs away with Judo leaving Bingo all alone. Now poor Bingo's heartbroken and Bluey needs to make amends.

programme.title: Bluey (S1) - Yoga Ball
programme.desc: Bingo loves playing with Dad, but sometimes he forgets Bingo is smaller than her sister. Mum teaches Bingo how to use her big girl bark to keep the fun within her limits.

programme.title: Supertato (S1) - Evil Pea's Big Freeze
programme.desc: Evil Pea freezes the veggies so she can take over the whole supermarket. Chilli's heat unfreezes Supertato who then races on lolly-stick skis to thwart Evil Pea and save the day.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S4) - Norrie's First Day
programme.desc: Norrie skips into the Clubhouse and greets her friends. As they greet her, they reminisce about when they first met.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S4) - The Moving Badge
programme.desc: Snail is thrilled to be moving house as she wishes to escape the wet and sploshy place she currently calls home to a more spacious house on the hill.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club (S1) - Potato Time
programme.desc: At Squirrel Club, Duggee forgets how to woof, Duggly comes to visit, Roly celebrates Potato Time, and Billy teaches everyone the Bugatron dance!

programme.title: Go Jetters (S2) - Rainforests of Sumatra, Indonesia
programme.desc: Can the Go Jetters save the world's stinkiest plant from becoming Glitch's latest perfume?

programme.title: Go Jetters (S2) - Go Jet Academy: Artificial Reef
programme.desc: Xuli finds a shipwreck on a coral reef and learns some glitches don't need to be fixed.

programme.title: Go Jetters (S2) - Machu Picchu, Peru
programme.desc: A giant grimbot bounces down the valley of Machu Picchu. Can the Go Jetters stop him?

programme.title: My World Kitchen (S1) - Larry's Chinese Tofu, Egg and Prawn
programme.desc: Larry is cooking steamed tofu, egg and prawn. China is famous for its wonderful food so Larry's friends are very excited to come over for his Chinese themed meal.

programme.title: Andy's Baby Animal Missions (S1) - Andy and the Baby European Pond Turtle
programme.desc: In this episode, Andy, Jen and Scout head off on a global adventure to the Danube river in Vienna, Austria on a baby animal mission to help a newly hatched European pond turtle reach water. Along the way, the intrepid team witness the emergence of ten million mayflies.

programme.title: Swashbuckle (S8) - Sandy and Seaweed's Treasure Trove
programme.desc: Squawk takes us on a journey to find Sandy and Seaweed's top Swashbuckle moments.

programme.desc: He-He Krash and Amelia play. Amelia tells everyone that her flight is the most interesting

programme.title: Bluey (S2) - Dance Mode
programme.desc: After Dad eats her last chip, Bingo is given three chances to put Mum and Dad in "Dance Mode" as payback. But the others can't resist taking Bingo's turns for her.

programme.title: Bluey (S2) - Hammerbarn
programme.desc: On a trip to Hammerbarn, Bluey and Bingo create their own mini-homes side-by-side in the trolley. But Bluey quickly gets jealous of her neighbour, Bingo.

programme.title: Bluey (S2) - Featherwand
programme.desc: Bluey and Mum are off to Chloe's party and Bingo isn't invited. But armed with a magic featherwand that makes things incredibly heavy, Bingo can now stop them leaving the house.

programme.title: Supertato (S2) - The Tato Team
programme.desc: During the Veggies' Super Sidekick Costume Contest, Evil Pea traps Supertato in a jar of honey. All is lost until the Veggies become real super sidekicks, the Tato Team!

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S5) - The In Charge Badge
programme.desc: What are the rules about being in charge? Make a plan, keep everyone happy, make decisions, lead by example and listen. Roly takes that one so seriously he gets a bit overwhelmed.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S5) - The Laughter Badge
programme.desc: From sensible chuckles and nervous giggles to Duggee's infectious laughter, once everyone starts, it's so hard to stop. What were they laughing about again? Anyone remember?

programme.desc: Loveable Duggee and the Squirrels return with more educational fun.

programme.desc: Betty recalls the first time she pushed the red button, the Squirrels explore a range of emotions with Happy, Angry Bull tells a not-so-sleepy bedtime story, and the gerbils sing.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club (S1) - Squirrel Babies
programme.desc: Spring has sprung! There are cute baby animals to meet and frolic with.

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Housework
programme.desc: Mum and Dad vow to only finish their boring housework when the kids stop acting silly, but that's never going to happen, so they end up trying the same approach themselves.

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Pass the Parcel
programme.desc: Lucky's Dad is outraged that modern Pass the Parcel has a present in every layer and changes the rules back to only having one prize in the middle, but Bingo is forever losing.

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Perfect
programme.desc: For her Father's Day card, Bluey sets out to draw a picture of herself and her father together. While recalling her favourite memories of playing with Bandit, Bluey struggles with the idea that her drawing must be perfect. Chilli tries to convince Bluey that perfection isn't easy, or absolutely necessary.

programme.title: Teletubbies (S1) - Musical Statues
programme.desc: Tinky Winky, Dipsy, Laa-Laa and Po enjoy a game of musical statues. It takes the Teletubbies a few turns to work out what to do when the music stops; they must stand very still.

programme.title: Teletubbies Ready Steady Go! (S1) - Silly Things
programme.desc: Join the dance party with the Teletubbies! Tinky Winky, Dipsy, Laa-Laa and Po dance and sing about silly things that make them smile.

programme.title: Pop Paper City (S1) - Zip's Movie
programme.desc: As everyone else gets their films ready for a big movie night, Zip still doesn't know what his film should be about. He wonders whether he will have a film to show at movie night after all.

programme.title: Dog Loves Books (S1) - Dog Loves Lighthouses
programme.desc: Dog and Pug have a power cut in the bookshop. They want to know what it was like before electricity and they go to an old lighthouse. The light is about to go out before the keeper can return.

programme.title: Let's Fall In Love
programme.desc: Da Yung, the son of a rich entrepreneur, meets Lian Lian, the niece of a kindergarten principal by chance. They fall into a misunderstanding on the first meeting, causing Da Yung to lose his wallet. Further misunderstanding occurs when he tries to get her to act as his fiance so as to drive away two women whom he does not like...

programme.title: The Lady Hermit
programme.desc: The Lady Hermit hides away for years to plot revenge after being defeated by the evil Black Knight. Young swordswoman Tsui Ping is determined to take down Black Knight herself and begs Lady Hermit to teach her martial arts skills. The Black Knight's days are numbered when the Lady Hermit and her protege perfect the technique to take him down.

programme.title: Scandal
programme.desc: The roguish scamp Zhen and his best friend Chia collects proof of corruption from the officials in this comedy-drama. After a string of blackmailing, they end up in positions of power, but what is to happen next?

programme.title: Woman of the Night
programme.desc: The movie offers three stories of love and obsession. In the first tale, a young student with a voyeuristic habit spies on two of his female roommates. The second story follows an office manager who develops an infatuation for his secretary. The last story is a complex family drama about a debilitated father who forces his family to leave him.

programme.title: The Silver Fox
programme.desc: The formidable swordswoman Silver Fox was a child when her father was senselessly wounded by his step brother, and her mother raped. It is payback time eighteen years later, as her father trains her up with kung fu to take revenge on his behalf.

programme.title: The Mad Monk Strikes Again
programme.desc: The Mad Monk is up against the equally legendary scholar-turned-genie, Lu Tung Pin. The duo create havoc as they vie with each other, be it in mirth, magic, women or weapons!

programme.title: The 36th Chamber of Shaolin
programme.desc: Gordon Liu plays an anti-Manchu rebel who escapes to the Shaolin Temple and learns what it truly takes to become a martial arts master by challenging the 35 Shaolin Kung Fu chambers, eventually creating the 36th chamber himself.

programme.title: The Singing Escort
programme.desc: Betty Ting plays Susan, a young woman hiding from her father by being a nightclub singer in Japan. Pop singer Chao Ke-jen (Lin Chong) gets permission from his boss to visit Japan, with the condition that he finds the boss's daughter. Boy finds girl, boy falls in love. But will the father approve?

programme.title: Duel Of Fist
programme.desc: Fan Ke discovers at his father's deathbed that he has a half-brother, Wenlie, in Thailand. He goes to find Wenlie, who became a boxer to support his sick mother. Following their encounter, the two got involved in the underworld of boxing match gambling.

programme.title: Return of the Phoenix
programme.desc: An imperial minister Cheng betroths his pretty younger daughter, Ye, to his friend's son, Mu. His wife however, refuses to let Ye marry before her elder daughter Yan, who is ugly and undesirable. Yan is asked to pretend as Ye to meet Mu but scares him away. A rich guy who likes Ye meanwhile pretends as Mu to attend the wedding...

programme.title: Man Of Iron
programme.desc: A fearless fighter, Chou Lian Huan has risen to power in Shanghai with his exceptional combat skills. He risks his life for hostess Shen Ju Fang and embarks on a series of fierce battles against the son of a notorious triad leader and his gang, ultimately becoming a scapegoat in the gang's deadly turf war.

programme.title: My Son
programme.desc: Kuo, a police's son, blames his father for his mother's death. He has no job, spends time in night clubs and always gets into fights. One night, Kuo rescues Mei from being raped and they become friends. Kuo wants to support Mei and her family so he goes gambling hoping to gain more money but bad luck seems to be following them with tragic outcomes.

programme.title: Full Moon Scimitar
programme.desc: Swordsman Ding fought against many swordsmen and won, so he took his first defeat badly and wanted to commit suicide. It is then that he meets the granddaughter of a mystic Sect leader and falls in love. When they want to get married, the Sect leader presents Ding with the "Full Moon Scimitar", on the condition that he will never leave the sect.

programme.title: A Place to Call Home
programme.desc: Li Ching, star of Sweet is Revenge, plays one of three daughters, whose life is turned upside down when she discovers she is adopted. But things get even worse when she goes in search of her real mother. Finally, after what is almost a double tragedy, she realizes what so many knew all along: There's no place like home.

programme.title: Lady Of Steel
programme.desc: A young swordswoman Fang Ying Qi sets out to join the Flying Dragon Clan in their defense against the invading Jin forces. Fang also intends to avenge the murder of her parents by bandit leader Han 20 years ago. Han has since taken on a false identity as a member of the Flying Dragon Clan and Fang must rely on her deadly sword skills to stop Han.

programme.title: Lady Of Steel
programme.desc: A young swordswoman Fang Ying Qi sets out to join the Flying Dragon Clan in their defense against the invading Jin forces. Fang also intends to avenge the murder of her parents by bandit leader Han 20 years ago. Han has since taken on a false identity as a member of the Flying Dragon Clan and Fang must rely on her deadly sword skills to stop Han.

programme.title: Big Times for the Crazy Bumpkins
programme.desc: Ah Niu finds a bag of jewels on the street and becomes rich. It is at this time that Uncle Zhou asks him to sign a contract to marry a girl, but it turns out to be a trap for Ah Niu to sell his house. In the end, Ah Niu becomes poor again...

programme.title: Legend of the Bat
programme.desc: It is rumoured that people can buy anything they desire on the mysterious Island of Bats so long as they have money. The charismatic swordsman Chu Liu Xiang and his friend travel to the island to seek answers but realize they are not the only ones who want to unveil the mystery of this place.

programme.title: Facets Of Love
programme.desc: Set in the Ming Dynasty, the story revolves around a brothel and the girls who work there. The film begins by following the life of a girl from a poor family, who is sold by her mother to the brothel. While she is the most beautiful of the girls and attracts many clients, the girl hopes to escape this sad way of life one day.

programme.title: The Swordmates
programme.desc: Li asks his swordmate Wang to protect his family while he is away, but Wang rapes his wife and even has his convoy attacked. Li escaped but fears his daughter is still in danger, so he asks the nephew of his master to help protect her...

programme.title: The Eight Diagram Pole Fighter
programme.desc: The Yang Generals were ambushed by the enemies and only two of the sons survived. The fifth son of Yang's escapes to Shaolin temple and learns the pole-fighting techniques from the monks, eventually creating his own "Eight Diagram Pole Fight" and teaming up with the Shaolin monks to avenge his family.

programme.title: Boxer Rebellion
programme.desc: The Empress Dowager Cixi believes the Boxers' claim that they have developed a kung fu that makes them impervious to weapons, thus declaring war against the alliances of eight foreign nations. The lack of weapons and good leadership in the Ching government allows the Eight Nation Alliances to take down Beijing.

programme.title: The Boxer From The Temple
programme.desc: A young monk, The Kid, was expelled from the temple due to his crazy ways. After leaving the temple, he fights a cruel bandit's son and befriends a prostitute. As he fights for justice, his "Crazy Lo Han Fist" improves with every fight.

programme.title: The Magnificent Concubine
programme.desc: Yang Gui Fei is the beloved concubine of Emperor Tang Ming Huang, who is so besotted with her that he leaves the running of the country to Prime Minister Yang Guo Zhong, the brother of Yang Gui Fei. The Prime Minister is corrupt and cruel to the army, causing them to revolt and endanger the throne. Yang Gui Fei is also implicated and kills herself.

programme.title: The Rebel Intruders
programme.desc: Thousands of displaced refugees rush to the southern towns to avoid the civil war in north China. Three such young men trained with martial arts skills become sworn brothers, and accidentally got involved in the battle of the rebel leaders in town when they save a refugee girl. Can they fight back against the rebel gangs?

programme.title: Mr Funny - bone
programme.desc: Join Mr Funny bone in a series of comic vignettes as he attempts to win the heart of a dashing lady. Along for the ride is his loyal sidekick Mr Big Potato, a stout fellow who is forever getting into silly mishaps. The pair gets involved in plenty of shenanigans and gags!

programme.title: The Golden Buddha
programme.desc: A map indicating the location of the Chan's family heirloom is hidden in three Golden Buddha statues. Paul, an insurance agent, finds one statue by chance and Chan's daughter has another one. This makes them targets of treasure-hunting criminals and they have to team up to defeat them before unveiling the hidden secrets.

programme.title: The Mad Monk
programme.desc: The movie consists of four stories of the Mad Monk helping others, from saving a mother and daughter from crumbling walls, to helping hawkers deal with bullies, recovering stolen money for a young man and punishing a devious court official and his son.

programme.title: The Chinese Boxer
programme.desc: A Japanese karate master and Diao Er, who has been expelled from his martial arts school, return to the school to kill the school master and his disciples. After the massacre, disciple Lei Ming embarks on a vigorous training regime and vows to avenge their deaths. A fatal battle is about to begin...

programme.title: Melody of Love
programme.desc: Three young doctors pursue three hard-to-get beauties in this romantic film set in the 70s "a-go-go" era. They have no idea where to start and use Rock-paper-scissor method to match themselves with the girls. The tactics and tricks they use are hilarious and they have to reshuffle their plans when nothing leads to success!

programme.title: Melody of Love
programme.desc: Three young doctors pursue three hard-to-get beauties in this romantic film set in the 70s "a-go-go" era. They have no idea where to start and use Rock-paper-scissor method to match themselves with the girls. The tactics and tricks they use are hilarious and they have to reshuffle their plans when nothing leads to success!

programme.title: The Shadow Whip
programme.desc: Three hundred thousand worth of silver is robbed by a thief using a whip as the weapon. As it is a signature weapon used by a martial arts master "Shadow Whip", he is suspected and hunted. No one sees him after that. Fifteen years later, a young girl Yang shows up using the same weapon. Who is this girl and what has happened to "Shadow Whip"?

programme.title: The Venus' Tear Diamond
programme.desc: Legendary rival jewel thieves Fragrant Night and Nocturnal Earl travel to Japan to steal the famous Venus' Tear Diamond. They fall quickly in love at first sight, without knowing the other person is their rival and is after the same prize. Who will get the diamond, and will it mean the end of their new found love?

programme.title: Black Magic 2
programme.desc: Doctor Sing is puzzled by the strange symptoms of his patients and asks his friend for help. The sickness is apparently caused by a black magic that is casted by a wicked man Kong. Kong covets the beauty of Sing's wife and casts an evil love spell on her, while threatening to kill Sing at the same time. Can Sing save his wife and his patients?

programme.title: The Supreme Swordsman
programme.desc: After beating several famous swordsmen, Chin Wu Hsin of the Mo Shan clan challenges Supreme Swordsman to a duel, hoping to win his title, and is beaten and humiliated. The winner taunts him to find a Supreme Sword made by Old Eagle, a famous sword-maker. When his offer to buy a sword from Old Eagle, is turned down, he challenges Old Eagle to a duel, and snatches his sword in a foul play. Old Eagle's own son Shih Yen-peh vows to avenge for his father...

programme.title: Temple Of The Red Lotus
programme.desc: A young guy Wu, heads off to the Dragon Valley to meet his childhood friend Lian Chu, who was promised to be his bride. When he arrives, he finds out that the family of his bride may not be an entirely honest bunch of people. Wu wishes to take Lian Chu with him, so he has no choice but to fight against her family...

programme.title: Carry on Doctors and Nurses
programme.desc: At St. Morant Hospital, a harried but lovely administrator must deal with lusty interns, student nurses, a delirious surgeon, a dissection fiend, a criticizing Commissioner and gross negligence at regular intervals! This comedy is based on the hugely successful British Carry On! film series.

programme.title: The Silent Swordsman
programme.desc: This is adapted from Louis Cha's "The Book and the Sword". A young swordsman is tasked to lead a patriotic secret society to fight the traitorous general who colludes with the enemy. At the same time, he encounters a female warrior and two beautiful princesses, and is caught between all their affections for him.

programme.title: The Enchanting Ghost
programme.desc: It is love beyond the grave, as a young scholar and his beautiful lover are torn apart forever by his dastardly uncle and his friend, who drive the girl to commit suicide... but with death comes revenge for the enchanting ghost. A spooky yet heart-wrenching tale...

programme.title: Call to Arms
programme.desc: The aggressive and dangerous Chin Empire conquers the hard-put Chao kingdom while the Wei empire is drained of its heroes and paralyzed by an indecisive ruler. Adventure, intrigue, death and tragedy reigns before the triumphant clash of the armies.

programme.title: A Taste Of Cold Steel
programme.desc: Gan Dai Xiong is killed by Prince Wu, who seeks to seize his Purple Sword. Prince Wu's son join forces with an evil gang to steal the Purple Sword from Gan Dai Xiong's three daughters. Eventually, Gan's daughters team up with their cousin Xu to avenge their father's death.

programme.title: A Friend from Inner Space
programme.desc: A young boy whose parents are separated tries to find happiness in life. One day, he meets and befriends a kind-hearted spirit Ren, who decides to make him truly happy by getting his parents back together.

programme.title: The Protectors
programme.desc: Ling Hsiao and Kuan Wang Lung are two guard chiefs working for an old convoy master. Lung is secretly in love with Fang Yen, the master's granddaughter but Yen is attracted to Ling Hsiao instead. In order to win her back, Lung sets up a trap to steal the convoy and frames Ling Hsiao for it.

programme.title: Mist Over Dream Lake
programme.desc: A young girl Chen is sent away by her parents who are going through divorce, to stay with the Chang's. On the Chang's farm, she meets their two sons, the youngest daughter and a young artist, and spends a summer with them that she will never forget.

programme.title: The Knight of Knights
programme.desc: Wen Su Chen, the leader of seven knights, sends his six sworn brothers to investigate a monastery. Unfortunately, they are killed by an abbot who plans to murder Inspector Lin. Wen saved Lin and battles the abbot to avenge his dead sworn brothers. With Lin and his army's help, they bring down the ruthless monks in the monastery.

programme.title: Na Cha the Great
programme.desc: Adapted from a chapter of the classic Chinese legend "Investiture of the Gods", this is the story of Na Cha set 3000 years ago. After Na Cha sacrificed his life to save his parents, he is reincarnated with his spirit embodied in a lotus flower and is armed with two magic weapons to save the people from their despotic emperor.

programme.title: Fist of Legend
programme.desc: When Chen Zhen studies in Japan, he finds several Chinese students missing and accidentally uncovers the Black Dragon Society's conspiracy. A new drug is invented to boost bodies of the Japanese troops in war and the Chinese students are used in their experiments. Chen Zhen vows to take down the evil society and destroy their secret laboratory.

programme.title: Mr Vampire II
programme.desc: Grave-robbing archaeologists unearth a family of preserved vampires and plan to sell them on the black market. However, they accidentally break the paper spells that had kept the vampires immobilized during transport. The vampires escape, but a local herbalist Lin is soon on their trail, determined to destroy them.

programme.title: Kowloon Walled City
programme.desc: Neng was a street fighter in Northeast China but decides to start a new life in Hong Kong's Kowloon Walled City. Unfortunately, he is implicated in the fights and conspiracies among the triad forces. When his good friend is hunted down by the triad, Neng must team up with the residents of Kowloon Walled City to fight back and save his friend.

programme.title: Seeding Of A Ghost
programme.desc: It's an erotic gore-fest starring Kao Fei who seeks vengeance against his wife's rapists and killers by soliciting the help of a demented magician. In return, he endures copulating dead bodies as his enemies perish in blood spurting and body exploding glory. It's one of Hong Kong goriest films ever made.

programme.title: The Grandmaster
programme.desc: Directed by the acclaimed filmmaker Wong Kar Wai, this epic action feature begins in Foshan when Ip Man, the martial arts master from the south, takes up a challenge by ageing northern master Gong Yu Tian. Ip Man wins the fight, but is then defeated by Gong Yu Tian's daughter Gong Er, with whom he forms an emotional bond...

programme.title: Prince Charming
programme.desc: Chen Li Pin, the nerdy son of a business tycoon, and his friend seek love in Hawaii. Returning home in disappointment, they accidentally find themselves in a messy identity swap. It is at this time that Chen falls for a beautiful girl May, who thinks he is a company chauffeur...

programme.title: The Sorcerer & The White Snake
programme.desc: In this action fantasy movie based on the Chinese legend of the White Snake, a young herbalist falls in love with a thousand-year-old white snake disguised as a woman. When the white snake's true identity is revealed, a sorcerer goes to battle believing that in doing so, he is restoring balance and order between man and the supernatural.

programme.title: Wusong VS Ximenqing
programme.desc: Wu Song finds out about his sister-in-law's affair with a rich man, Ximen Qing. Qing sets Song up and have him exiled for a year, during which his hapless brother is murdered and cremated. When Song finally returns home, he takes the case to court but the judge brushes it aside and closes it abruptly. Can Song finally avenge his brother's death?

programme.title: Cherie
programme.desc: Cherie Chung plays the title character in this sexy romance as a fitness instructor who attracts the attentions of a wealthy businessman and a handsome photographer.

programme.title: Iceman
programme.desc: Falsely accused of murder, Ming Dynasty Imperial Guard Ying is pursued by his three sworn brothers until a fierce battle leaves all four entombed in ice. Four hundred years later, they awaken in modern Hong Kong, where they must reignite their ancient feud in a world they can barely recognize.

programme.title: Mr Vampire Saga 4
programme.desc: A Buddhist monk and Taoist priest put aside their differences to take on vampires that have been struck by lightning and have now become a super powered threat to mankind.

programme.title: Fight Back to School
programme.desc: SDU officer Chow Sing Sing goes undercover at a school to locate a missing gun. With his partner Tat, he successfully recovers the weapon, only to stumble upon a munitions smuggling ring. In retaliation, the smugglers storm the school and take students hostage, forcing Sing to risk everything to save them.

programme.title: Painted Faces
programme.desc: This is based on the real-life story of Master Yu Jim Yuen who strives to run his academy in the 1960s, even as the opera culture is declining. Three young men, Sammo Hung, Jackie Chan and Yuen Biao, are determined to train under Master Yu and undergo extremely tough training before they become three of Hong Kong's biggest stars

programme.title: Iceman the Time Traveler
programme.desc: In this sequel, the four imperial guards are defrosted and reanimated in modern Hong Kong. Driven by a single goal to obtain the Golden Wheel of Time and right the wrongs of the past, Ying embarks on a perilous quest, unaware that every step draws him deeper into a deadly trap.

programme.title: Love on Delivery
programme.desc: A delivery boy Yin wants to impress his dream girl Li, so he enrols in a martial arts course to learn strange moves. Being timid, Yin saves Li while wearing a Garfield mask but the credit is stolen by Karate Master, Liu. To prove himself and win Li back, Yin defeats Liu in the ring with his unique martial arts move "Invincible Wind and Fire Spin".

programme.title: Love on Delivery
programme.desc: A delivery boy Yin wants to impress his dream girl Li, so he enrols in a martial arts course to learn strange moves. Being timid, Yin saves Li while wearing a Garfield mask but the credit is stolen by Karate Master, Liu. To prove himself and win Li back, Yin defeats Liu in the ring with his unique martial arts move "Invincible Wind and Fire Spin".

programme.title: Paper Man
programme.desc: As the police investigate a gang murder case, another mysterious paper man murder happens, and the suspects get killed one by one. Continuing to track the clues of the case, the police finally unveil a hidden secret and tragedy over two generations.

programme.title: The Lost Bladesman
programme.desc: An epic historic adventure set during the turbulent times of the Three Kingdoms. Cao Cao attempts to enlist Guan Yu into his forces, but Guan is loyal to his sworn brother Liu Bei, who is also Cao's enemy. As Guan tries to rescue Liu Bei's concubine from Cao, he is forced to fight his way through. Can he succeed in the end?

programme.title: Girl with the Diamond Slipper
programme.desc: An aspiring TV actress gets into hot water when a stolen diamond is hidden in the shoes she bought for a party.

programme.title: Shark Busters
programme.desc: During the financial crisis, a vast majority of Hong Kong people experience difficulties in repaying debts. During this time, loan sharks use ruthless ways to force debtors to repay their loans and it is up to Officer Lee and his underground team to hunt down the head of this illegal organization.

programme.title: Detrimental
programme.desc: You Ji Ren is a blind man who works at a factory in an outlying island. When the factory is cut off from the outside world by a hurricane one day, a monster appears and turns whoever sees it into black shadows. As You cannot see the monster, he is able to help other coworkers leave safely and fight to kill the monster!

programme.title: The Grey Men
programme.desc: Hong Kong police officer Ah Shan goes undercover in prison to gain the trust of criminal Tian, in order to seek evidence against his gang. After their release from jail, Shan helps Tian rise within the gang and become the new boss. However, just as Shan successfully cracks down on the gang, he uncovers a shocking secret about Tian...

programme.title: Impermanence
programme.desc: A series of strange events is happening in a peaceful village, including a corpse that is resurrected from its grave and ran away. As the villagers investigate, a villain dies and the village head also goes missing. Police investigation ensues, but as the truths start to unveil, more mysteries are unfolding. Who is the one behind them all?

programme.title: Perfect Girls
programme.desc: Chi will inherit his dying grandfather's fortune with one condition - he has to be married in a month, otherwise the money goes to his uncle, Robert. Chi falls in love with Siu Siu, but Robert intends to stop them by sending Moraine to seduce Chi. When Moraine decides to marry Chi for money, Robert stops her and reveals their plot.

programme.title: Bangkok Storm
programme.desc: Underground boxer Lin Feng is hunted by the Bangkok triad when he refuses to fight in an illegal match. He escaped successfully but lost his memory. While Feng begins a new life, the triad finds him and hires a top boxer to beat him. As Feng suddenly regains his memory in the process, he vows to take down the triad.

programme.title: My Darling Genie
programme.desc: A genie who is trapped in a Chinese oil umbrella helps an honorable young man and his uncle to deal with a covetous loan shark.

programme.title: Royal Tramp II
programme.desc: The leader of Dragon clan, Long Er, helps General Wu to overthrow Emperor Kang Xi. However, Long Er is betrayed by General Wu and is rescued by Xiao Bao. As a result, she bestows her virginity and martial arts power to Xiao Bao to fight against Wu. At the same time, Xiao Bao fortuitously unveils the hidden treasures from "The Sutra of 42 Chapters".

programme.title: Flying Swords of Dragon Gate
programme.desc: This is a remake of the original 1966 classic, Dragon Gate Inn. The country is being policed by the East and West Bureaus, whilst the Emperor's eunuchs have attained much power and control. With all the corruption, Zhao teams up with a group of assassins to systemically kill the eunuchs in order to save the country.

programme.title: How to Choose a Royal Bride
programme.desc: The Empress Dowager has arranged for a Minister's daughter Qiong Yao, to become Emperor Kangxi's concubine. However, Qiong Yao escapes in pursuit of freedom in marriage and Kangxi is happy to not go through with the union. When Kangxi travels incognito to Jiangnan, he serendipitously encounters Qiong Yao, who disguises herself as a man...

programme.title: Teenage Dreamers
programme.desc: Ting Ting is a student in an all-girl high school. She tries out for the school's stage production of Romeo and Juliet with an all-boy school and promptly falls for the lead, Jackson. While Ting Ting is swept away by the excitement of her first love, Jackson turns out to be more of a player than a partner.

programme.title: Hero
programme.desc: Ma Wing Jing and his brother arrive in Shanghai to make their fortune. Befriending a powerful mobster Tam, Ma is given his nightclub when he saves Tam's life. Ma's fortune rises but he must overcome the corruption and violence to survive.

programme.title: Hero
programme.desc: Ma Wing Jing and his brother arrive in Shanghai to make their fortune. Befriending a powerful mobster Tam, Ma is given his nightclub when he saves Tam's life. Ma's fortune rises but he must overcome the corruption and violence to survive.

programme.title: The Illegal Immigrant
programme.desc: This is a gritty and realistic Chinatown tale about the life of a Chinese illegal immigrant and his journey in New York. He is looking for a fake marriage with a girl so as to gain the right of abode there. Despite all the hardships and misfortunes, he tries to cope with life and reach for his dreams.

programme.title: Open the Coffin
programme.desc: Ghost Hand and his tomb raiders resurface in Jiang City to seek gold in ancient tombs after a 3-year absence. They released an evil spirit from a coffin and all four died at home eventually. Poison and pinholes in the corpses become the sole clue for police investigation. A tomb raid now unfolds as a perplexing and mysterious case.

programme.title: Destiny's Champion
programme.desc: An aging fighter relives the mistakes of his violent past through a poor and streetwise kid, who severely injures his nemesis during a battle to win a girl's heart.

programme.title: Painted Face
programme.desc: Scholar Wang Huai Qing sells paintings to save his ailing wife. He is attacked by a bird demon along the way but is rescued by Fox demon Xiao Rong. To elude the pursuit, Wang brings Xiao Rong home, sparking a love triangle and at the same time, unfolding an impending love between human and demon.

programme.title: Song of the Assassins
programme.desc: A young assassin is assigned his first mission while secretly investigating the cause of his family's massacre years ago. While taking on the mission, he finds himself entangled in a political conspiracy that was planned for years and has to use his skills as an assassin to solve whatever comes his way.

programme.title: Mid-night Two
programme.desc: Yi Cheng and his friends venture into a haunted mountain that hides an ancient corpse and an eternal ghostly flame. No one who enters the mountain ever returns and at 2:30 AM, Yi Cheng's friends vanish one by one. While searching for them in the eerie forest, Yi Cheng enters a realm of infinite reincarnation, facing a series of terrifying events...

programme.title: The Bare-footed Kid
programme.desc: A poor, bare-footed young man from the countryside arrives in the city to work with the friend of his dead father. When their dye shop is burnt down by a local strongman, he decides to fight back to protect all of them and save the shop.

programme.title: Behind the Yellow Line
programme.desc: A fresh graduate, Paul, strikes up an acquaintance with a pretty young girl, Monica, on the metro. Monica is involved in a love affair with a married man while Paul is also pursued by a rich girl. When Paul vows his true love for Monica, she suggests playing hide-and-seek with him in the metro to decide if they are fated to be together.

programme.title: Out of the Dark
programme.desc: An old lady died after mysteriously falling off a building and her ghost appears to haunt the place. This freaked out the security guards, who invite ghostbuster Leo and his female assistant to help. In the process, Leo finds out that the old lady was killed by her son and daughter in law. To rest her soul, Leo promises to bring the couple to justice.

programme.title: Munitions Hijacking Case
programme.desc: Agent Wen is assigned to work undercover for a Southeast Asian military arm dealer to find some munitions and to destroy them. When he finally finds the munitions though, he is attacked by unknown gangsters and has to team up with his partner to recover the munitions so as to prevent a disaster from occurring.

programme.title: Women
programme.desc: Bo Yi's husband is having an affair, so Bo Yi divorces him and joins the "Happy Spinsters Club" set up by her friends. However, she soon finds out that she does not enjoy being single and while sorting out her thoughts, her repentant husband begs her forgiveness. She must now decide on what she truly wants.

programme.title: Hidden Heroine
programme.desc: A drug cartel is entrenched in the Dong Zhou area. Mei Jing of the Thunderbolt Women's Commando Unit, leads her team to attack the drug base, but they are being ambushed and the identity of Mei's father as an undercover is exposed. After a fierce battle, Mei and her team manage to successfully defeat the drug cartel and rescue her father.

programme.title: The Last Tycoon
programme.desc: Gangster Chen Da Qi rises to the upper echelons of power, but finds himself torn between the love of two women, the murderous plots of the secret service, and the looming threat of war.

programme.title: Fight Back to School II
programme.desc: Following his demotion, officer Sing resigns from the police force and goes undercover at an international school to privately investigate a terrorist plot. There, he discovers bumbling detective Tat posing as a teacher. Forced into an alliance, they team up to confront the heavily armed criminals behind the plot in a chaotic showdown.

programme.title: Lifeline
